title: RESEARCH AND PR CONTENT SPECIALIST
description:
SMHQ JOB DESCRIPTION: RESEARCH AND PR CONTENT SPECIALIST



===================================

ABOUT SMHQ

===================================

SMHQ runs two connected UK property websites. SMHQ Network (
) is a licence and franchise business aimed at property investors who want to find motivated sellers, with 58 people currently in the franchise network. 
 is our main lead generation website, where we find motivated sellers directly, generating over 4,000 motivated seller leads in the last year.



===================================

ROLE SUMMARY

===================================

We're looking for a research and PR content specialist to turn our own lead data into original research that positions SMHQ as a leading voice in the property industry, and earns us high-quality backlinks and press coverage.



Each month, the goal is to produce one piece of original research based on patterns in our motivated seller and below-market-value (BMV) lead data. For example, identifying that a specific town generates a disproportionately high number of BMV leads compared to similar or even much larger areas, and turning that into a proper research write-up. From there, the role covers writing press releases, pitching that research to local and national newspapers and media outlets, and pushing it out across our own social channels, with the aim of getting other outlets and industry influencers to pick it up and quote us. This is genuinely three roles combined: researcher, PR writer, and content/SEO writer, and we're looking for someone comfortable across all three.



As with all our roles, we're looking for someone with a good attitude and a genuine growth mindset, who wants to learn and grow. We want people who will stay with us long term and become loyal, trusted team members.



===================================

MUST-HAVE SKILLS

===================================

Research and analysis

- Comfortable working with data and spotting genuinely interesting patterns or stories in it

- Able to turn raw data into a clear, credible research write-up or report



Press release writing and outreach

- Strong press release writing

- Experience pitching stories to journalists, newspapers, or media outlets

- Understanding of what makes a story newsworthy enough to be picked up



Content and SEO writing

- Strong general writing ability

- Understanding of backlink-focused and SEO-friendly content



===================================

NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS

===================================

- Existing media or journalist contacts

- Experience working in or writing about the property industry

- Social media copywriting experience

- Design skills for simple charts or report graphics



===================================

APPLICATION EVIDENCE REQUIRED

===================================

Applicants should provide examples of previous research write-ups, press releases, or articles that were picked up by media outlets, along with any backlink or coverage results if available.



===================================

HOURS AND PAY

===================================

20 to 40 hours per week. Pay negotiable based on experience.



===================================

PROCESS

===================================

1. Watch the short intro video linked below first, it explains the role and how we work.

2. Fill out the application form, which asks you to rate your relevant skills with evidence, and include a short work sample.

3. Shortlisted candidates move to a short interview, where we'll be looking closely at attitude and mindset as well as skill.

4. Strong candidates move to a short unpaid work trial, purely to confirm you can genuinely do the job.

5. Candidates who show the right skills, attitude, and mindset move to a longer paid work trial.

6. Successful candidates are offered the ongoing role.



===================================

LINKS

===================================

title: Finance & Operations Associate
description:
Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!



Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT). 

Visit our website: 



Position: Finance and Operations Associate

Work Schedule: US Hours (EST)

Employment Set-up: Remote (Independent Contractor)  

Employment Type: Full-Time / Long-Term

Salary Range: USD 1,500 - 1,800 / Month

Benefit: PTO and HMO after the 120-day probationary period

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-monthly

Equipment: Self-Provide



Job Summary:



Wingz is looking for a Finance & Operations Associate based in the Philippines to join our growing remote team. This is a full-time, remote-first position designed for a well-rounded professional who brings financial acuity and operational discipline together,  someone who can move fluidly between numbers, processes, people, and stakeholder communication without losing pace or precision.



This is not a siloed accounting role. You will work across finance, operations, client relations, and team development. You will be expected to think critically, communicate clearly with leadership and executives, build and improve the systems the business runs on, and take genuine ownership of your work.

We are specifically seeking talent in the Philippines — a market that consistently produces high-caliber remote professionals. If you are serious about building a long-term remote career, contributing at a level that matters, and growing within an organization that recognizes strong performance, this role is for you



Key Responsibilities:



Finance & Accounting:

• Manage day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, and financial records using the organization's accounting tools

• Prepare accurate and timely financial reports, summaries, and data presentations for leadership and stakeholders

• Analyze financial data to surface trends, flag variances, and provide actionable interpretation — not just raw numbers

• Support budget tracking, reconciliation, and month-end close processes

• Ensure compliance with internal financial policies and any applicable regulatory requirements

• Demonstrate adaptability across accounting and bookkeeping platforms — QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks, or others as the business requires



Operations:

• Create, document, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), workflows, and process guides that the team can actually use

• Regularly review existing processes against business data and drive improvements — identify inefficiencies before they become problems

• Support the implementation and rollout of new operational updates, tools, and organizational changes with thoroughness and compliance

• Coordinate across departments and functions to ensure operational continuity and alignment

• Contribute to data analytics efforts — collect, organize, interpret, and present operational data in clear formats for decision-making



Client Communication & Relationships:

• Serve as a professional point of contact for clients — written and verbal communication must reflect Wingz's standards at all times

• Build and maintain strong client relationships through consistent, proactive, and reliable communication

• Handle client inquiries, escalations, and follow-ups with clarity, professionalism, and appropriate urgency

• Understand client needs deeply enough to anticipate issues and communicate solutions before they are asked



Leadership & Team Development:

• Lead or co-lead a team — previous team leadership experience is required, and you will be expected to step into that role here

• Actively nurture the career development of team members and direct reports — coaching, mentoring, and feedback are part of the job, not optional

• Model accountability, clear communication, and high standards for your team

• Identify skills gaps and growth opportunities within the team and raise them with leadership constructively



Leadership & Executive Communication:

• Communicate directly and explicitly with executives, leadership, and stakeholders — no ambiguity, no over-hedging

• Prepare clear updates, reports, and briefings that give decision-makers exactly what they need without burying the point

• Raise issues, risks, and recommendations proactively — leadership should never be the last to know

• Represent the team and the work confidently in any forum — written memos, verbal updates, or live meeting



Requirements:

What We Are Looking For:

• Minimum 3 years of combined, relevant experience spanning finance/accounting and operations — not one or the other, both

• Demonstrated experience leading or managing a team in any capacity

• Track record of building or improving SOPs, workflows, or business processes

• Background in client-facing roles where communication quality directly affected outcomes

• Experience working in a remote environment is strongly preferred — you understand remote discipline, async communication, and self-management

• We do not require experience with any one specific tool. We require the mindset and capability to learn and use whatever the business runs on.



Communication:

• Solid English communication — both written and verbal — is non-negotiable. You will be communicating with US-based leadership, executives, and clients

• Written: reports, SOPs,
 correspondence, and internal documentation must be clear, concise, and professional at all times

• Verbal: you must be comfortable speaking in team meetings, client calls, and leadership briefings — articulate, confident, and direct

• You communicate with intention. You do not leave room for misinterpretation when it matters



Who You Are:

• You are passionate about remote work — not because it's convenient, but because you treat it as a serious career path and show up accordingly

• You are dedicated — to your craft, your team, and the organization you represent

• You are a critical thinker — you question processes, look for root causes, and bring solutions, not just observations

• You are explicit — in what you communicate, what you need, and what you expect, whether speaking to a team member or an executive

• You invest in your team — you genuinely care about the growth of the people you work with and make time for it

• You follow through — on compliance, on implementation, on commitments. The business can count on you

• You adapt — to new tools, new processes, and organizational changes without friction or complaint

As a Software Engineer (Django + React Native) at Wingz, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining backend APIs and mobile application features. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-performance software supporting our NEMT platform.

This role requires strong experience in Django/Django REST Framework and at least 1+ year of hands-on experience with React Native.



Key Responsibilities:



Develop and Maintain Web Applications:

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable APIs using Django REST framework

• Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following best practices and coding standards.

• Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.



Develop and Maintain Backend & Mobile Application

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable APIs using Django and Django REST Framework.

• Build and enhance mobile application features using React Native for iOS and Android.

• Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following industry best practices.

• Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of backend services and mobile applications.



Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams:

• Work closely with front-end developers, designers, and product managers to implement new features and improve existing ones.

• Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback to ensure code quality.

• Collaborate with DevOps engineers to optimize deployment processes and infrastructure.



Database Management:

• Design and optimize database schemas.

• Write efficient queries and manage database migrations.

• Ensure data integrity and security.



Testing and Debugging:

• Write unit tests and perform debugging to ensure the reliability of applications.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a timely manner.

• Conduct regular performance testing and optimize code for better performance.



Documentation and Technical Support:

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of the codebase and technical processes.

• Provide technical support and guidance to tea
mbers and stakeholders.

• Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to continuously improve skills and knowledge.



Requirements:



• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in web development using Django and Django REST framework.

• Proficiency in Python, Django, and Django REST framework.

• At least 1 year of hands-on experience in React Native mobile development.

• Strong understanding of front-end technologies, such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

• Experience with RESTful APIs and web services.

• Familiarity with database systems (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.).

• Knowledge of version control systems, particularly Git.

• Experience with Docker and containerization is a plus.

• Understanding of cloud services (AWS, GCP, etc.) is advantageous.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies.

title: Market Operations Associate
description:
Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!



Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT). 

Visit our website: 



Position: Market Operations Associate

Work Schedule: US Hours (EST)

Employment Set-up: Remote (Independent Contractor)  

Employment Type: Full-Time / Long Term

Salary Range: USD 950 - 1,200 / Month

Benefit: 10 PTO and HMO after the probationary period

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-monthly

Equipment: Self-Provide



Job Summary:



Market Operations keeps our markets running: enough verified drivers on the road, every trip assigned before the day begins, and every trip completed on time. You'll own a piece of that and be measured on it. This is a decision-making role, not a scripted one — you'll make calls, act, and explain your reasoning afterward. If you're looking for phone-based client support with defined procedures, our Client Support Specialist opening is the better fit.

How your responsibilities are assigned



The responsibilities below cover everything Market Operations does across five areas. You will not be responsible for all of them.



During the hiring process, we'll evaluate where your strengths fit best, and you'll start in one area. Your assignment is confirmed before you accept the offer, so you'll know exactly what you're taking on. Over time, you'll be cross-trained into more.



Read this as the map of the team you're joining, and your starting point within it.



Responsibilities:

1. If assigned to Driver Onboarding & Activation

• Make fast first contact with new driver applicants and guide them through the application

• Run onboarding interviews, group and 1:1, and d
 who advances

• Review driver documents for accuracy and compliance, and coach applicants through corrections

• Coordinate background checks and screenings, and follow up until cleared

• Run activation calls so new drivers are confident on the app before their first trip

• Keep the roster current: expiration outreach, reactivation checks, and removing inactive drivers



2. If assigned to Dispatch & Scheduling

• Build driver schedules and assign trips against them

• Sweep the current week for schedule gaps and fill them before trips go uncovered

• Work inside our AI-assisted dispatching tools, producing and acting on the daily output

• Flag where the tooling gets it wrong so it improves

• Notify drivers of schedule changes



3. If assigned to OTP Specialist

• Monitor on-time performance live and intervene before a trip goes late, not after

• Own urgent trip reassignments end to end: the decision, driver contact, and resolution

• Keep clients informed before they have to ask

• Step in when leads are tied up so nothing waits in a queue



4. If assigned to Routing Specialist

• Build and adjust routes for efficiency and reliability

• Make sure drivers activate GPS well ahead of pickup

• Chase and coach drivers who don't, before it becomes a data gap

• Protect billing and claims accuracy by keeping trip data complete



5. If assigned to Market Associate

• Cover a portion of all three areas above in a newer or smaller market

• Shift week to week toward whatever is currently limiting the market

• Flag early which area is about to break



Every Market Operations Associate, in every area

• Own your daily and weekly targets, and know where you stand without being asked

• Resolve problems in your area rather than handing them off

• Escalate what's genuinely above your authority, with what you've already tried and what you recommend

• Keep driver and trip records accurate in every system you touch

• Improve the procedures you work from, and document the ones that don't exist yet

• Cross-train as backup on one adjacent area

• Bring us patterns, not just i



Requirements:



Required

• 2-4 years in operations, dispatch, logistics, or program coordination, a role where you owned an outcome, not just a queue

• Sound judgment without a script. Much of this work has no procedure for the situation in front of you

• Comfort with tradeoffs. Some days you can cover one trip or the other, not both, and you'll need to d
 quickly and defend the call

• Comfort being measured daily. You should want the scoreboard, not avoid it

• Ability to hold several threads at once and switch between them without dropping any

• Strong written and verbal communication — most areas involve daily calls with drivers

• Composure when things break. Some days are interrupt-driven and won't go as planned

• Detail accuracy where a missed date or wrong record has real consequences

• Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to learn new tools quickly

• Willingness to work ET hours, including weekend or holiday rotation depending on assignment

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet space for video calls



Preferred

• NEMT, healthcare transportation, or other regulated service experience

• Dispatch, fleet, or last-mile operations background

• Applicant tracking or recruiting platform experience

• Experience running group interviews or high-volume onboarding

• Experience with AI-assisted operational tooling

title: Content Creator - Music Education
description:
Thank you for your interest in this role!



This position supports an online curriculum platform for elementary music teachers. The business creates curriculum materials, lesson plans, teaching resources, and professional development for general music educators.



This role focuses specifically on developing social media content from ideas, source material, and creative direction. You will work with me to turn educational ideas and raw materials into polished content that feels cohesive, thoughtful, and distinctly on-brand.



The brand look is inspired by Rifle Paper Co., Anthropologie, and Montessori. The visual style is warm, sophisticated, educational, and thoughtfully designed.



A willingness to learn the brand deeply and study existing content is essential. You will be expected to notice patterns across previous work and carry those patterns into new content.



If you have strong creative judgment, excellent attention to detail, a sharp eye for visual design, and the ability to take an idea and figure out how to turn it into finished content, you'll thrive here!



Work Vibe:



This position requires a high level of creative thinking, attention to detail, and independent judgment. However, it is imperative to me that all team members enjoy their work. Expect a positive work environment with extremely high standards.



You will have flexibility in creating your own schedule and completing work during the hours that fit your workflow. Projects will be assigned with clear deadlines, and I expect work to be completed accurately and early, or at the very latest, by the deadline.



I am looking for someone who wants to become deeply familiar with the brand and take pride in making the work better over time.



Salary increases will follow a consistent schedule and will be based on job performance. You’ll know ahead of time what I’m looking for at each increase, that way you can move toward your desired hourly rate. 



--------------------------------------------



RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Content Development

- Develop content for social media (Instagram and YouTube), and teaching materials (Google Slides, worksheets, etc.) 

Take rough ideas, voice memos, written notes, transcripts, and other source material and develop them into polished Instagram content

- Develop Instagram carousels by determining the structure, organization, copy, and visual presentation

- Turn a creative direction into a finished piece without requiring every individual decision to be specified

- Determine the most effective way to communicate an idea visually and in writing

- Adapt content while preserving the original meaning and intent

- Recognize opportunities to develop existing ideas into additional pieces of content



2. Short-Form Video Editing

- Take raw video footage and develop it into polished Instagram Reels

- Select and arrange footage appropriately

- Edit unnecessary pauses, mistakes, and portions that do not contribute to the finished piece

- Add accurate subtitles and simple text or graphic elements

- Make thoughtful decisions about pacing, formatting, and visual presentation

- Ensure finished videos are properly formatted and ready for publication

- Maintain consistency with the editing style established across previous content



3. Brand Consistency and Visual Development

- Study existing social media content and learn the visual and editorial patterns of the brand

- Apply established typography, spacing, layouts, colors, imagery, and other visual conventions consistently

- Maintain a cohesive visual identity across different types of social media content

- Recognize when a piece of content feels inconsistent with the established brand and make appropriate adjustments

- Develop new visual treatments that feel consistent with the existing brand rather than relying on generic social media templates

- Use strong visual hierarchy, balance, alignment, and composition across all content



4. Editorial Review and Attention to Detail

- Proofread all content before submitting it for review

- Check spelling, grammar, punctuation, capitalization, and formatting

- Check subtitles carefully for accuracy

- Review spacing, alignment, typography, and readability

- Compare new content with previous work to maintain consistency

- Notice repeated ideas, phrases, formats, or visual treatments across recent content

- Identify anything that looks unfinished, inconsistent, or out of place before it reaches me

- Take responsibility for delivering work that is fully reviewed and publication-ready



5. Creative Thinking and Independent Judgment

- Make thoughtful creative decisions based on the goals of each piece of content

- Work effectively from incomplete or informal creative direction

- Determine when an idea needs clarification and when a decision can reasonably be made independently

- Think critically about how information should be organized and presented

- Adapt quickly when creative direction changes

- Use previous work as a reference when making decisions about new content

- Bring ideas and observations to the creative process rather than simply waiting for instructions



6. Collaboration and Implementation

- Work collaboratively to develop and implement planned social media content

- Receive creative direction and translate concepts into finished products

- Communicate proactively about progress, questions, and potential blockers

- Ask thoughtful questions when additional information is genuinely needed

- Incorporate feedback efficiently and apply that feedback to future work

- Become increasingly independent as you learn the brand, workflow, and expectations



----------------------------- 



REQUIREMENTS 



You do not need to come into this role with a background in music education. However, you will be expected to learn the music terminology, notation, and pedagogy necessary to work accurately with the content. This will be part of your onboarding and ongoing work.



Successful candidates use the Adobe and / or Affinity product suite for illustration  



Most importantly, I'm looking for someone with excellent creative judgment, strong visual taste, independent thinking, and an unusually high attention to detail.

title: Appointment setter / Inbox manager & Warm caller
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



FlowLead runs outbound
 and LinkedIn campaigns for B2B clients. We are hiring a confident Warm Caller and Inbox Appointment Setter to turn interested prospect replies into sales meetings.



You will get replies from prospects who have shown interest, respond to and call them in under five minutes, answer questions, follow up, and book meetings on our clients’ calendars.



You will work with multiple clients, each with a different offer. We provide clear SOPs, training videos, templates, client information, and regular alignment calls to help you succeed.



This is a performance-driven role with opportunities to earn more as your results, skills, and responsibilities grow.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Respond to and call positive leads in under five minutes during assigned working hours.

- Learn each client’s offer and qualification criteria.

- Answer questions, handle common objections, and book qualified meetings.

- Follow up consistently with interested prospects who have not booked through calling.
s and LinkedIn follow-ups are automatic.

- Use approved frameworks and AI drafts while checking every response for accuracy.

- Keep prospect statuses and call notes accurate.

- Attend training and alignment calls.



COMPENSATION AND TRIAL



- Initial 14-day paid performance trial: $20 for every qualified meeting booked.

- After successfully completing the trial: $250 guaranteed monthly base salary plus $10 for every qualified meeting booked.

- Expected earnings are approximately $550 per month when performing at target.

- Earn an additional $50 monthly bonus if your average first-response time is below five minutes for eligible replies received during your assigned working hours.

- Additional performance goals and financial rewards will be introduced based on your results, skills, and level of responsibility.



Each client has different qualification criteria. These requirements and all performance targets will be clearly explained during training and before each measurement period.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



-
 replies are accurate, natural, persuasive, and appropriate for each prospect.

- Calls are confident and conversational, with strong listening, rapport-building, and objection-handling.

- Interested replies are consistently converted into qualified meetings.

- Fast response times are maintained without sacrificing the quality of the reply or call.

- Follow-ups are completed consistently so promising opportunities are not forgotten.

- Booked meetings are relevant, properly qualified, and have a strong attendance rate.

- Problems are approached proactively by using available information and resources to find solutions.

- Prospect information and call notes remain accurate and organized.

- Communication with the FlowLead team is reliable, professional, and proactive.



TRAINING AND SUPPORT



You will receive written SOPs, training videos, approved templates, client information, and other resources covering the complete role.



The training includes:



- Positive-reply and inbox management.

- Writing natural and effective responses.

- Calling warm prospects confidently.

- Handling questions and objections.

- Understanding client offers and qualification criteria.

- Following up and booking meetings correctly.

- Using the required tools.



We will also hold onboarding and regular alignment calls to review performance, provide coaching, resolve blockers, and ensure everyone remains aligned.



Our calling material is a guide rather than a word-for-word script. We want someone who can follow a proven process while communicating naturally and confidently.



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time position covering Monday-Friday, 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time.



U.S. daylight-saving changes will shift the corresponding working hours in the Philippines.



You must remain available throughout the assigned coverage window because responding to and calling interested prospects in under five minutes is a core responsibility.



TOOLS



You may work with:



- Our own internal
 inbox tool

- LeadHero for calling

-
Bison

- Slack

- Calendly

- Zoom

- ChatGPT



ChatGPT may be used through client-specific projects to help draft prospect replies. You will remain responsible for checking accuracy, improving the draft, and ensuring every response sounds natural.



Experience with these exact tools is helpful but not required if you are comfortable learning new software quickly.



REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent spoken and written English with a confident, professional speaking voice.

- Experience in appointment setting, warm calling, sales, inbox management, or customer communication.

- Comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers.

- Able to respond to and call positive leads in under five minutes.

- Natural, persuasive communication without sounding aggressive or overly scripted.

- Organized and detail-oriented enough to manage multiple clients and conversations.

- Dependable, coachable, and comfortable receiving direct feedback.

- Reliable availability during the required U.S. working hours.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, quality headset, quiet calling environment, and a backup plan for internet or power problems.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short and specific application. Honest answers are more useful than generic AI-written responses.



Please include:



- Your resume.

- Your earliest available start date.

- A video of yourself answering all seven questions below.



Please answer the questions in order:



1. Why do you want this job? What motivates you, and what are you hoping to learn, achieve, or gain from this opportunity?



2. Describe your experience with appointment setting, warm calling, sales, inbox management, or customer communication. Give at least one specific example.



3. An interested prospect says they want more information instead of agreeing to a meeting. How would you handle the situation and move the conversation forward?



4. Pretend you are calling a prospect who just replied positively to one of our
s. Demonstrate how you would open the call and move the conversation toward a meeting.



5. What would you do if you were unsure how to answer a prospect’s question or could not figure out the correct next step?



6. Confirm that the Monday-Friday, 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time schedule, the 14-day paid performance trial, and the regular compensation structure work for you.



7. Describe your computer, internet connection, headset, calling environment, and backup plan for internet or power problems.



HIRING PROCESS



Application review, short interview, and a practical warm-call or inbox role-play for selected candidates.



Candidates will not receive sensitive client data or production access during the hiring process.

title: Elementary Music Illustrator
description:
Thank you for your interest in this role!



This position supports an online curriculum platform for elementary music teachers. The business creates curriculum materials, lesson plans, teaching resources, and professional development for general music educators.



This role focuses specifically on **creating original illustrations and visual assets from ideas, source material, and creative direction**. You will work with me to turn educational ideas and raw materials into polished illustrations and graphics that feel cohesive, thoughtful, and distinctly on-brand.



The brand look is inspired by **Rifle Paper Co., Anthropologie, and Montessori**. The visual style is warm, sophisticated, educational, and thoughtfully designed.



A willingness to learn the brand deeply and study existing content is essential. You will be expected to notice patterns across previous work and carry those patterns into new illustrations and visual assets.



If you have strong creative judgment, excellent attention to detail, a sharp eye for visual design, and the ability to take an idea and figure out how to turn it into a finished visual, you'll thrive here!



**Work Vibe:**



This position requires a high level of creative thinking, attention to detail, and independent judgment. However, it is imperative to me that all team members enjoy their work. Expect a positive work environment with extremely high standards.



You will have flexibility in creating your own schedule and completing work during the hours that fit your workflow. Projects will be assigned with clear deadlines, and I expect work to be completed accurately and early, or at the very latest, by the deadline.



I am looking for someone who wants to become deeply familiar with the brand and take pride in making the work better over time.



Salary increases will follow a consistent schedule and will be based on job performance. You’ll know ahead of time what I’m looking for at each increase, that way you can move toward your desired hourly rate.



--------------------------------------------



**RESPONSIBILITIES**



### 1. Educational Illustration



* Create original illustrations for curriculum materials, teaching resources, social media, and other educational content

* Take educational ideas, written descriptions, sketches, and creative direction and translate them into clear, engaging illustrations

* Create illustrations that communicate music education concepts, classroom activities, movement directions, game formations, and teaching concepts

* Develop visual solutions that make educational information easier and more engaging for elementary music teachers

* Adapt illustrations for different formats and uses while maintaining visual consistency

* Create original visual assets that can be used across multiple pieces of content



### 2. Graphic Design and Visual Development



* Create polished graphics and visual assets for social media, website content, teaching materials, Google Slides, worksheets, and other curriculum resources

* Apply strong visual hierarchy, balance, alignment, composition, and typography

* Develop layouts that feel intentional and visually cohesive

* Create new visual treatments that feel consistent with the established brand rather than relying on generic templates

* Work from existing examples and established visual conventions when developing new materials

* Prepare finished artwork in the appropriate format for its intended use



### 3. Brand Consistency and Visual Development



* Study existing content and learn the visual patterns of the brand

* Apply established typography, spacing, layouts, colors, illustration styles, and other visual conventions consistently

* Maintain a cohesive visual identity across different types of materials

* Recognize when an illustration or design feels inconsistent with the established brand and make appropriate adjustments

* Develop new illustrations and visual treatments that expand the existing visual language while remaining recognizably on-brand

* Pay close attention to the relationship between illustrations, typography, layout, and surrounding content



### 4. Editorial Review and Attention to Detail



* Review all artwork carefully before submitting it for review

* Check spelling, typography, formatting, alignment, spacing, and proportions

* Ensure illustrations accurately reflect the creative direction and source material

* Compare new work with previous materials to maintain consistency

* Notice repeated visual elements, styles, or treatments across recent work

* Identify anything that looks unfinished, inconsistent, or out of place before it reaches me

* Take responsibility for delivering work that is fully reviewed and ready for use



### 5. Creative Thinking and Independent Judgment



* Make thoughtful creative decisions based on the goals of each project

* Work effectively from incomplete or informal creative direction

* Determine when an idea needs clarification and when a decision can reasonably be made independently

* Think critically about how an educational concept can be communicated visually

* Adapt quickly when creative direction changes

* Use previous work as a reference when making decisions about new illustrations

* Bring ideas and observations to the creative process rather than simply waiting for instructions



### 6. Collaboration and Implementation



* Work collaboratively to develop and implement planned projects

* Receive creative direction and translate concepts into finished illustrations and visual assets

* Communicate proactively about progress, questions, and potential blockers

* Ask thoughtful questions when additional information is genuinely needed

* Incorporate feedback efficiently and apply that feedback to future work

* Become increasingly independent as you learn the brand, workflow, and expectations



-----------------------------



**REQUIREMENTS**



You do not need to come into this role with a background in music education. However, you will be expected to learn the music terminology, notation, and pedagogy necessary to create accurate educational illustrations. This will be part of your onboarding and ongoing work.



Successful candidates have strong experience with **Adobe and/or Affinity products**, particularly for illustration and graphic design.



Most importantly, I'm looking for someone with **excellent creative judgment, strong visual taste, independent thinking, and an unusually high attention to detail.**



-------------------------------

The role will focus on reviewing seller leads inside the CRM, preparing basic lead notes, making outbound calls using a provided script, sending follow-up
s when needed, and working toward setting qualified appointments with our team.



The ideal candidate should have strong real estate outreach experience, fluent English communication, a confident phone presence, and proven experience converting leads into appointments.

Work Type: Remote, paid trial to start

Trial Hours: 10 hours initially to test performance

Timezone: Eastern Standard Time

Rate: $33/hour

Required Experience: At least 5 years of relevant experience

Language Requirement: Fluent English with a clear, professional tone and accent



Main Responsibilities



The VA will be responsible for:



Logging into the CRM each morning to review prospective seller leads

Reviewing homeowner details and doing light research before outreach

Calling prospective sellers using the provided script

Sending follow-up
s when needed

Logging call activity, lead notes, hours worked, and outcomes

Working toward setting appointments with the team through Zoom, coffee meetings, or phone calls

Focusing on homeowners who may have tried to sell, are currently trying to sell, or may be considering selling their home

Keeping accurate records of outreach activity and lead status

Providing clear updates on call results, interested leads, callbacks, and booked appointments

Required Experience and Skills



The ideal candidate must have:



At least 5 years of experience in real estate appointment setting, cold calling, lead generation, or sales outreach

Proven experience converting leads into appointments

Strong spoken English with a fluent, confident, and professional tone

Experience calling homeowners, seller leads, expired listings, FSBO leads, warm leads, or similar real estate prospects

Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills

Ability to follow a script while still sounding natural and conversational

Experience working inside a CRM

Strong attention to detail when logging notes, call outcomes, and follow-up activity

Ability to work independently and stay consistent with daily outreach

Comfortable working Eastern Standard Time hours

Preferred Experience



The following experience would be a plus:



Prior experience supporting real estate agents, investors, brokerages, or property professionals

Experience calling homeowners who previously listed, attempted to sell, or may be considering selling

Experience setting appointments for Zoom calls, phone consultations, or in-person meetings

Familiarity with seller lead follow-up and real estate CRM workflows



Voice Recording and Lead Research Requirement



Candidates must be willing to complete a short voice recording as part of the screening process.



This will not only be a basic script reading. Candidates will be asked to showcase both their call delivery and research ability by finding or creating a sample lead scenario that fits one of the provided sample scripts.



The candidate should use the script as a guide, not as a word-for-word template. The goal is to assess whether they can sound natural, conversational, and prepared when speaking with a prospective homeowner.



The recording will be used to assess:



English fluency

Tone, accent, and phone presence

Confidence and professionalism during the call

Ability to research and understand a sample homeowner lead

Ability to personalize the opening based on the lead situation

Ability to use the script naturally instead of reading it word for word

Ability to approach the call in a way that feels relevant to the homeowner

Overall fit for real estate seller lead outreach and appointment setting



Candidates should be able to demonstrate that they can review basic lead details, understand why the homeowner may be a potential seller, and approach the call with context rather than sounding like a generic cold caller.



Paid Trial



The engagement will begin with a 10-hour paid trial at $33/hour.



The purpose of the trial is to test performance, call quality, appointment-setting ability, CRM note accuracy, and overall fit for the role.



During the trial, the VA will be expected to provide clear call logs, hours worked, lead notes, and outcomes so performance can be reviewed before continuing.

Add: Senior Appointment Setter in the subject line.

The primary focus of this role is to build, manage, and improve systems in GoHighLevel, including CRM organization, workflows, automations, calendars, and
 campaigns. The VA will also assist with light financial administration, platform updates, and process documentation.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys improving systems, solving technical problems, and turning manual processes into organized and reliable workflows.







SHIFT

This is a part-time position with Monday and Thursday U.S. EST evening hours. 5 hours / day







KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

1. GoHighLevel and CRM Management

- Build, test, and maintain GoHighLevel workflows and automations.

- Set up and manage calendars, appointments, reminders, and notifications.

- Create and schedule
 campaigns and automated

- Create or update landing pages and forms using provided content.

- Monitor integrations and troubleshoot automation issues.

- Confirm that workflows and systems are working correctly.

- Recommend ways to replace manual Google Sheets and Google Docs processes with more efficient systems.



2. Light Financial Administration

- Assist in reviewing and organizing approximately four months of income and expenses.

- Match Stripe payments and transactions with records in Google Sheets and Xero.

- Help confirm that income and expenses are assigned to the correct business accounts.

- Assist with organizing and reconciling two business accounts.

- Identify and report missing, unclear, or unmatched transactions.

- Help improve and document the financial administration process.



Formal bookkeeping experience is not required. The client will provide training and guidance. However, you must be comfortable working with numbers and handling financial information accurately and confidentially.



3. Website, Program, and Administrative Support

- Upload client communications, resources, and program materials to UpCoach.

- Add blog posts and make simple content updates in Framer.

- Assist with basic scheduling and coordination when needed.

- Organize shared files and records in Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets.

- Turn training recordings and new workflows into clear written SOPs.

- Support future backend projects related to coaching programs, retreats, book promotions, book clubs, launches, and events.



You will not be required to design or build a website from scratch.



Required Qualifications



- Strong hands-on experience using GoHighLevel.

- Experience building workflows, automations, calendars,
 campaigns, and CRM systems.

- Strong technical and troubleshooting skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organizational and administrative skills.

- Comfortable working with numbers and financial records.

- Detail-oriented and able to handle confidential information responsibly.

- Proactive, dependable, and clear in communicating progress, questions, and concerns.

- Able to work independently after receiving clear instructions.

- Able to learn new software and processes quickly.

- Comfortable documenting processes and creating SOPs.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is an advantage but not required:



- Stripe

- Xero

- Google Workspace

- Framer

- UpCoach

- Landing pages and forms

- Basic bookkeeping or financial reconciliation

- Coaching or online program platforms



If you believe you're a strong fit for this position, please respond with the following:



1. A link to your resume in PDF format. 



Your resume should include your contact details, a recent professional photo, and a summary of your work experience, emphasizing tasks relevant to this role.



2. A screenshot of your PC specifications and internet speed, 



3. Your WhatsApp number for easy communication. 



4. A portfolio or samples of GoHighLevel workflows, automations, landing pages, or CRM systems you have created, if available. 



To ensure you've read this message carefully, please include the word "Workflows" in the subject line of your
.



We look forward to reviewing your application!

This role is best for someone who is reliable, fast, follows specifications precisely, and can adapt to different brand voices. title: B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – Marketing & Web Design
description:
# B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – Marketing & Web Design



We are looking for a confident, highly motivated **Cold Caller / Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to help us reach local businesses in the United States and book qualified sales appointments.



This is NOT a general administrative VA position.



Your primary responsibility will be **calling business owners and decision-makers, identifying potential opportunities, and booking qualified appointments.**



## What We Sell



We provide services to small and medium-sized businesses, including:



* Website design and website redesign

* Lead generation

* Digital marketing

* Advertising and customer acquisition

* Landing pages and conversion optimization

* AI-powered business and marketing solutions



Our services typically range from **one-time website projects to $1,500–$2,000+ monthly marketing retainers.**



You will NOT be expected to build websites or manage advertising campaigns.



Your job is to **start conversations and book qualified meetings.**



## Responsibilities



* Make outbound cold calls to U.S.-based businesses

* Speak directly with owners, managers, and decision-makers

* Follow our provided calling scripts and sales framework

* Identify businesses that may need marketing, lead generation, or a better website

* Ask basic qualification questions

* Handle common objections

* Book qualified prospects directly onto our calendar

* Follow up with interested prospects

* Record calls, notes, outcomes, and follow-ups in our CRM

* Meet daily and weekly activity targets

* Give feedback on objections and patterns you're hearing in the market



## Who We're Looking For



You MUST:



* Speak excellent, clear English

* Be confident speaking with American business owners

* Have previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing, or SDR experience

* Be comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

* Know how to get past gatekeepers

* Be comfortable handling rejection

* Sound natural rather than simply reading a script

* Be organized with follow-ups

* Have reliable high-speed internet

* Have a quality headset/microphone

* Have a quiet working environment

* Be available during U.S. Central Time business hours



Experience with CRMs, dialers, lead-generation software, or AI tools such as Claude is a plus.



## Compensation



monthly pay + performance incentives.



Bonuses will be available for qualified appointments and/or clients generated from your appointments.



There is significant room for growth for someone who consistently produces results.



## How To Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile

2. A short description of your cold-calling experience

3. Industries you have previously cold-called

4. Your average number of calls/dials per day

5. Your availability during U.S. Central Time

6. A **60–90 second voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at this position



Also answer:



**A business owner says: "We're already happy with our website and marketing." How would you respond?**



Start your application with the words text me on WhatsApp 
Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

We are a commercial heating and cooling company looking for an experienced HVAC Drafter to join our team. We are looking for someone who has strong HVAC drafting experience, a solid understanding of HVAC systems, and the practical knowledge and common sense to produce accurate drawings with minimal supervision.



The successful candidate will be able to understand project requirements, interpret technical information, and translate concepts into professional, accurate HVAC drawings. You should be comfortable working independently and be able to identify potential issues rather than simply drafting exactly what you are told.



Key Responsibilities

Prepare accurate, professional HVAC drawings for commercial heating and cooling projects.

Interpret project requirements, specifications, architectural drawings, and other technical information.

title: Instagram VA — Daily Posting & Engagement (iPhone Required)
description:
Read this fully before applying. Applications that skip the questions at the bottom are deleted without a reply.



THE JOB

I need one reliable person to run the daily Instagram activity for a fashion & lifestyle account. Long-term, ongoing work.



This is a simple routine job, not a creative or strategic role. I'm honest about that on purpose: if you're looking for a career step or something challenging, you will get bored and quit, and we both lose. If you want steady, predictable work you can do in under an hour a day, this is a good fit.



WHAT YOU DO EVERY DAY (30-45 minutes):

- Post 1 reel or feed post from the content I give you (already made — video, caption, hashtags, audio all prepared)

- Post 1-2 stories

- Reply to comments and simple messages in English

- Tick off a short checklist and upload a screenshot as proof

- in the beginning if you will get a completely new account. One Time setup and in the first 3x times a day a thirty minute warm up session for the account including following, scrolling, commenting, liking etc. 



You never have to create content or think up captions. What matters to me is only this: it gets posted, on time, every single day.



REQUIREMENTS

- iPhone 11 or newer, running the current iOS. No Android, no emulator, no borrowed phone. (An older iPhone cannot run the apps reliably — I've tried.)

- Written English good enough to reply to US followers naturally

- Stable internet and a fixed time each day you can post

- You can receive USDC on the Ethereum network. This is how everyone gets paid here — there is no PayPal, GCash or bank option. Please don't apply if this doesn't work for you.



PAY

$40/month to start, paid on time, every month. A raise after 3 months if the posting has been consistent. Roughly 5 hours a week.



TO APPLY — answer all five, in order:

1. Which iPhone do you have, and which iOS version? Attach a screenshot of Settings > General > About.

2. How many other Instagram accounts do you manage right now?

3. Can you receive USDC on Ethereum? Yes or no.

4. What time (Manila time) can you post every day, including weekends?

5. A follower comments: "you look so pretty, where is this place?" — write the exact reply you would send.



Question 5 is the one I actually read. Short, natural, friendly English is what I'm looking for.



Start your message with the word ORANGE so I know you read this.

title: FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR
description:
The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

Ad creative (10% of time)

/Instagram) campaigns

Daily output expectations

Requirements

Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

title: Descript Video Editor
description:
Descript Video Editor



Trendstop fashion trend forecasting agency is looking for a Descript Video Editor to join our team and help us turn existing recordings into clear, polished and engaging video content.



Our video content includes online workshops and website demos, website training videos and social reels. This is a hands-on editing role with Descript at the centre of the workflow, including using its AI and script-based editing tools to make the production process faster and more efficient.



What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll take existing recordings and turn them into polished, ready-to-publish videos. Your work will include:

- Using Descript’s AI tools to clean up and optimise recordings, including improving audio and removing filler words, pauses and other unwanted content.

- Editing videos using Descript’s script/transcript editor, particularly to turn longer recordings into shorter, more focused versions.

- Reviewing recordings and using good editorial judgement to d
 what can be removed while retaining the important information and natural flow.

- Tightening pacing and removing mistakes, repetition, unnecessary explanations and technical interruptions.

- Adding and editing overlay slides, screenshots, graphics and other supporting visuals.

- Selecting and inserting appropriate B-roll clips to make videos more engaging and visually varied.

- Creating, correcting and formatting subtitles so they are accurate, readable and consistent.

- Editing screen recordings, presenter footage and voiceovers.

- Reformatting existing content to create short-form social reels.

- Applying consistent branding, layouts and visual styles across our videos.

- Quality-checking finished videos for editing, audio, subtitles and visual accuracy.

- Exporting videos in the correct resolution, aspect ratio, quality and file format for their intended use, including videos for WordPress website pages and social platforms.

- Keeping Descript projects, source recordings and supporting assets organised.

- Making revisions based on feedback.



What We’re Looking For



- You should be confident and experienced with Descript and comfortable using it as your primary video editing platform.

We’re looking for someone with:

- Strong practical experience editing video in Descript.

- Good knowledge of Descript’s AI-powered editing and audio tools.

- Experience using script/transcript-based editing to efficiently shorten and restructure recordings.

- The ability to take a long recording and turn it into something shorter, clearer and more engaging.

- Experience working with screen recordings, demonstrations, webinars, workshops or training content.

- Experience adding slides, overlays, screenshots, graphics and B-roll.

- Good subtitle editing and formatting skills.

- Experience creating short-form and vertical video content.

- A good understanding of video formats, aspect ratios, resolution, compression and export settings.

- An understanding of preparing and optimising video for web use, including WordPress pages.

- Strong attention to detail and good editorial judgement.

- The ability to work independently and efficiently across multiple videos.



About You



- You don’t just know how to make cuts – you understand why and where to make them.

- You can look at a long workshop or training recording, quickly understand what matters and use Descript to turn it into a much tighter finished video without losing the key information.

- You’re comfortable using AI to speed up the editing process, but you also know where human judgement is required. You notice awkward cuts, inaccurate subtitles, unnecessary pauses, inconsistent audio and sections where an overlay or B-roll would make the content easier to understand.

- You’re also comfortable with the technical side of delivery and can make sure the finished video is correctly formatted and optimised for wherever it will be published.



Our Content



You’ll primarily be working on:

- Online workshops & website demos · Website training videos · Social reels

- The source material will often already exist, so a significant part of the role is about editing, improving, shortening and repurposing recordings rather than producing videos from scratch.



How to Apply



- Please send us your CV and examples of video editing work.

- We’d particularly like to see examples of work created in Descript, as well as screen-recorded tutorials, training content, webinars or workshops and short-form social videos.

- Please also tell us briefly about your experience using Descript’s AI and script-based editing tools and which features you use regularly.

A growing building services company is hiring a part-time Virtual Assistant to take on the admin workload around project tendering and documentation — work currently carried by the Project Coordinator on top of their broader role. You'll prepare and maintain tender pricing spreadsheets, complete project returnable documents and Record of Works (ROW) documents, compile and send Invitations to Tender (ITTs) to contractors and suppliers, and enter Supplier Invoices against Purchase Orders in simPRO.



This is a documentation- and detail-heavy role rather than a phone-heavy one. You'll need strong written English, confidence building and maintaining more complex Excel spreadsheets, and comfort learning simPRO's invoicing and reporting functions. A formal procedure only exists for the Supplier Invoice task so far, currently being documented by the team's existing VA. The other four task areas will be trained live by the Project Coordinator, and you'll help turn that training into usable SOPs as you go, the same way it's worked for the rest of the team.



Working Hours: Part-time, approx. 20 hours/week to start (potential for more hours after a few months, subject to review) Position Type: Part-Time Virtual Assistant



What You'll Own



Tender & Project Documentation



Complete project returnable documents for each tender submission

Prepare and update tender pricing spreadsheets in Excel

Complete Record of Works (ROW) documents for project works

Compile and
 Invitations to Tender (ITTs) to contractors and suppliers



Supplier Invoice & Purchase Order Management



Enter Supplier Invoices against Purchase Orders for project works in simPRO

Follow the Supplier Invoice procedure (currently being finalised by the team's existing VA); flag discrepancies between invoice and PO before processing

Extract reports and data from simPRO to support job and project reporting



Process Documentation & SOP Development



Document processes for tasks that don't yet have formal procedures — returnable documents, tender pricing, ROW documents, ITTs — working from live training delivered by the Project Coordinator

Draft and refine SOPs as your familiarity with each task grows, following the same approach that's worked well for the rest of the team

What We're Looking For



Experience



Priority will be given to candidates with direct simPRO experience and a background in building, construction, trades, or a related industry

Administrative, documentation, or project support experience — ideally within building, construction, trades, or a related industry

Prior hands-on use of simPRO strongly preferred, particularly supplier invoicing and reporting functions — candidates without simPRO experience should have exposure to a similar job management platform

Experience preparing tender or quote documentation is a plus, though not mandatory if you're a fast learner



Technical Skills



simPRO — confident entering Supplier Invoices against Purchase Orders and extracting job/project reports (training provided)

Microsoft Excel — intermediate to advanced, able to build and maintain more complex spreadsheets (tender pricing)

Microsoft Office Suite — general proficiency across Word, Outlook, and related tools

Windows-based hardware — the client has a strong preference for Microsoft/Windows setups over Mac, based on onboarding issues experienced previously



Non-Negotiables



Catches pricing errors, missing returnable documents, or incomplete ROW paperwork before they become a problem

Naturally documents what they do and turns live training into a usable SOP without being chased

Manages several tender and invoicing tasks concurrently without losing precision

Produces clear, professional written correspondence for tenders and contractors

Works through a defined task list independently once trained — no daily hand-holding needed

Fast learner across new platforms and project-specific documentation requirements

Calm and methodical under deadline-driven paperwork — no rushing, no cut corners

Collegial team player — builds trust as a second remote team member alongside the existing VA and Project Coordinator



Why This Role



Be the second remote VA placement with this business, joining a team that's already seeing strong results from this model

Real ownership: five distinct task areas, confidently run with minimal supervision by day 90

A business that values process — your SOPs become the standard others follow

Room to grow: hours may increase after the first few months as workload is reassessed

title: Full-Stack Web Developer + Paid Media Manager
description:
Job Overview

We’re looking for an experienced full-stack web developer who can also serve as a Paid Media Manager. You’ll own projects end-to-end from design through development, AI generated content, SEO, and paid digital advertising across Google Ads.



This is not a traditional team-based role. You will largely work independently, taking websites from concept to fully implemented, high-performing WordPress sites built with Elementor. You will also manage content (using AI tools), SEO, and paid media campaigns that actively drive customer acquisition.



You’ll be responsible for planning, launching, managing, and optimizing advertising campaigns across multiple platforms. This role is for someone who doesn’t just turn campaigns on. The selected candidate will actively monitor performance, identify opportunities, test new ideas, solve problems, and continuously improve results. You should be comfortable working independently, making data-backed recommendations, and taking full ownership of both website delivery and campaign performance from strategy through optimization.



Key Responsibilities

Web Design & Development



Design and develop responsive, high-quality websites in WordPress using Elementor (from wireframes/mockups or from scratch).

Handle both UI/UX design and front-end/back-end development independently.

Build, maintain, and optimize sites for performance, accessibility, conversion, and landing-page effectiveness.

Use AI tools to accelerate design, development, and iteration while maintaining professional quality.



Content & SEO



Manage website content using AI-assisted workflows (creation, editing, optimization, and publishing).

Develop and execute SEO strategies (technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, and ongoing monitoring).



Paid Media (Google Ads)



Plan, launch, manage, and optimize advertising campaigns with Google Ads

Conduct audience research and targeting.

Perform keyword research and campaign planning.

Manage budgets and allocate spend effectively.

Set up and analyze conversion tracking and attribution.

Write or recommend high-converting ad copy and creative.

Run A/B tests and campaign experiments.

Make landing-page optimization recommendations.

Continuously monitor, analyze, and optimize campaign performance.

Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.

Identify opportunities to improve ROI and scale successful campaigns.



Required Qualifications



Proven experience developing websites in WordPress with Elementor.

Strong skills in both design (visual design, UX/UI) and development within the WordPress ecosystem.

Hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads.

Experience with audience research, keyword research, budget management, conversion tracking, ad creative/copy, A/B testing, landing-page optimization, performance analysis, and reporting.

Comfort and demonstrated ability working independently from design through full implementation and from campaign strategy through optimization.

Experience leveraging AI tools to increase productivity and output quality across design, development, content, SEO, and advertising.

Analytical, proactive, detail-oriented mindset with a passion for using data to drive growth.

Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, or other performance marketing tools is highly preferred.

Availability that includes at least one hour overlapping with Eastern Time (EST) business hours.



What We’re Looking For

Someone who is self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning the full lifecycle of both web projects and paid media performance. You should be able to move quickly with AI assistance while still delivering polished results, testing new ideas, and making recommendations that improve marketing outcomes. This role carries significant responsibility and requires a high degree of independence.



How to Apply

Your resume / portfolio (highlighting WordPress + Elementor projects, design work, SEO results, and paid media campaigns across Google, Meta, and/or TikTok)

Examples of campaigns you’ve managed and results achieved

Build content that attracts buyers, not random views. No trends for the sake of trends



SCRIPTING & FILMING DIRECTION



Script a full month of short-form content in advance

WHAT YOU EDIT DIRECTLY



Instagram and TikTok Stories,  built from scratch, roughly 15 sales-focused stories a month

Static and photo posts, what to post, how often, how it should look, and the actual edit

Captions, hooks, and CTAs across everything



WHAT YOU COORDINATE, NOT EDIT



Reels and long-form video go to my video editor. You brief them, communicate the creative direction, and review the cut against the script before it goes out. You're the bridge between strategy and the edit , not the one cutting it



UPLOADING & SCHEDULING



Post and schedule everything across both platforms



COMMUNITY & DMs

Summarise recurring themes and questions back to me weekly, that's raw material for content and product

MONETISATION & REPORTING



CTAs that route people to DMs, the freebie, and the
 list (once the product is launched)

Track leads and conversions, not vanity metrics

Monthly reporting against those milestones



PLEASE INCLUDE IN YOUR APPLICATION



Your work style — how much direction do you need from me, and where do you prefer to run independently?

Deadlines — what's the cadence for scripts, calendar, and posting, and what do you need from me each week to keep it moving?

Your rate and what's included at that rate.

title: Ecom Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for a **skilled e-commerce video editor to join our team long-term** and help us produce high-converting direct-response ads for Meta, TikTok, and other paid social platforms.



This is **not a one-off project**. We’re looking for someone who wants consistent work, can handle a steady creative workload, and is interested in **growing with the brand over time**.



You should already have experience editing **e-commerce ads**, including formats such as:



* UGC ads

* VSL-style ads

* Mashups

* Native-style ads

* Advertorial/story-driven creatives

* Direct-response product ads



We’ll provide scripts, raw footage, creative direction, and references. Your job is to turn those assets into ads that **grab attention, maintain retention, and drive conversions.**



### Responsibilities



* Edit raw footage into high-converting direct-response ad creatives

* Turn scripts and creative briefs into finished ads

* Create strong, engaging openings that hook viewers within the first few seconds

* Edit UGC, VSLs, mashups, native ads, and other e-commerce creative formats

* Use B-roll, captions, motion graphics, sound effects, music, pattern interrupts, and visual callouts where appropriate

* Match reference ads while also bringing your own creative judgment to the edit

* Create multiple variations of winning concepts when needed

* Make revisions based on feedback and ad performance

* Maintain **fast and consistent turnaround times**

* Communicate clearly and respond quickly



### Requirements



* **Proven experience editing e-commerce/direct-response ads**

* Strong portfolio of paid social ads you have personally edited

* Experience with **UGC, VSLs, mashups, and performance creatives**

* Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, retention, storytelling, and direct-response editing

* Ability to make an ad feel native to platforms like Meta and TikTok

* Ability to follow detailed creative briefs without needing constant supervision

* Excellent attention to detail

* Reliable communication

* **Fast turnaround — typically 1–3 days depending on the project**

* **Full-time or near full-time availability**

* Ability to handle a consistent volume of creatives every week

* Strong desire to work with us **long-term and grow alongside the brand**



### What We Provide



* Finished scripts and ad angles

* Raw footage and UGC

* Creative briefs

* Reference ads

* Examples of previous winning creatives

* Clear feedback and direction

* Consistent work for the right editor



### Important



We are **not looking for someone whose main focus is making videos look cinematic or pretty.**



These are **performance ads.**



Every editing decision should serve a purpose:



**Hook attention ? maintain retention ? communicate the message ? drive action.**



You should understand how to use pacing, visuals, B-roll, captions, pattern interrupts, emotional moments, and sound design to make someone continue watching.



Most videos will range from approximately **30 seconds to 2 minutes**, although some VSL-style creatives may be longer.



### Long-Term Opportunity



We want to build a relationship with **one or more reliable editors who can become a core part of our creative team.**



If you consistently:



* Deliver quality work

* Hit deadlines

* Communicate well

* Learn from feedback

* Understand direct-response creative

* Help us improve creative output



…there will be **consistent ongoing work and room for greater responsibility as we grow.**



### To Apply



Please include:



1. **3–5 examples of e-commerce/direct-response ads you personally edited**

2. Examples of any **UGC, VSL, or mashup-style ads**

3. Your typical turnaround time

4. Your availability each week

5. Your rate per edited video

6. The editing software you use

7. A short explanation of your experience editing ads for Meta/TikTok



**Put the word YELLOW at the very top of your proposal so I know you read the entire job post.**



Applications without relevant e-commerce ad examples will not be considered.

Legal Calls is hiring a hands-on marketer who can own the entire path from ad click to booked call. You will build and run Meta ad campaigns, design the landing pages and funnels those ads point to, and write the copy that makes them convert.



This is a builder role, not a strategy-deck role. We want someone who can go from "here's the offer" to a live, tested funnel without needing a team behind them. If you like owning the numbers and iterating fast, you'll do well here.



What You'll Do:



-Plan, launch, and manage Meta 
/Instagram) ad campaigns end to end — audiences, creative testing, budget pacing, and scaling what works

-Build and maintain landing pages and multi-step funnels (opt-in ? qualification ? booked call)

-Design ad creative and page layouts that look clean and credible in a legal/professional context

-Write the copy: ad hooks, headlines, landing page body, form microcopy, follow-up
 and SMS sequences

-Set up and verify tracking — Meta Pixel, Conversions API, UTMs, and event mapping — so reporting is trustworthy

-Run a continuous testing cycle on creative, hooks, offers, and page structure

-Report weekly on spend, CPL, cost per booked call, and what you're changing next

-Use Claude to move faster on copy variations, research, data analysis, and page/QA work



What You Need to Have:



Meta Ads

-2+ years running paid social campaigns with real budget responsibility (please be ready to say what monthly spend you've managed)

-Comfortable inside Ads Manager: campaign structure, audience setup, retargeting, A/B tests, and diagnosing a campaign that's underperforming

-Working knowledge of Pixel and Conversions API setup, plus iOS-era attribution realities



Funnels & Landing Pages

-You've built landing pages and funnels yourself in tools like GoHighLevel, Unbounce, Webflow, Framer, ClickFunnels, Leadpages, WordPress/Elementor, or similar

-You understand what actually moves conversion rate: above-the-fold clarity, form friction, page speed, mobile layout, proof and trust signals

-You can wire up form submissions, CRM handoffs, and automated follow-up



Design

-A real eye for layout, hierarchy, spacing, and type — your pages look professional, not templated

-Can produce your own ad creative and page assets (Figma, Canva, Photoshop, or equivalent)



Copywriting

-Native-level written English. Your copy should be clear, persuasive, and free of awkward phrasing

-You can write a hook, a headline, and a page that sells without sounding hyped or spammy — this matters in a legal-adjacent market



Working with Claude

-You use Claude (or comparable AI tools) daily as part of how you work — drafting and rewriting copy, brainstorming angles, analyzing performance data, generating page HTML, summarizing research

-You know the difference between AI output that's ready to ship and AI output that needs a human rewrite. We will ask about this

General

-Available for live calls 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM PST on weekdays

-Reliable communicator — you flag problems early instead of going quiet

title: Cheff of Staff - Ecommerce Operations

Marketing Team Coordination & Execution

, and content teams

- Create simple, effective project frameworks and SOPs that actually get used

mbers, contractors, and agency partners



Drive Results & Accountability

- Anticipate risks before they become problems
