- Own outcomes, not just outputs



What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

- You’ve taken ownership of 3–5 active initiatives and brought clarity to what was chaos

- Marketing team projects are running smoother with clear workflows and timelines

- Founders have visibility into what’s happening without having to ask

- You’ve implemented 2–3 automations that save the team hours every week

- The team actually uses the systems you’ve built



You’re a Great Fit If You Have

Must-Haves

- 8–12 years working in ecommerce or digital businesses (agency, brand, or marketplace side)

- Direct experience managing ecommerce operations on platforms like Shopify, Amazon, Wayfair, or Walmart

- Strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals and campaign execution — you’ve coordinated marketing teams or projects before

- Startup or high-growth company experience where you wore multiple hats and figured things out

- Hands-on experience with project management tools (Asana strongly preferred)

- Track record of building systems, SOPs, and processes from scratch — not just operating within existing ones

- Proven ability to lead and manage people with real authority — not just coordinate

- Track record of getting things done in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

- Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)

- Experience managing remote teams across time zones

- Tech-savvy mindset — comfortable with new tools and AI/automation



Bonus Points

- Experience working directly with founders or C-suite as their operational right hand

- Background in catalogue management, product launches, or creative operations

- Hands-on experience with automation tools (Zapier, Make, ChatGPT, n8n)

- Knowledge of SEO, marketplaces, or ecommerce analytics

- Experience scaling a business from early stage — you’ve seen what breaks at $1M, $5M, $10M



Tools You’ll Work With

- Project & Collaboration: Asana, Notion, Slack, Loom, Google Workspace

- Ecommerce Platforms: Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, marketplace dashboards, ERP/OMS tools

- Automation & AI: Zapier, Make, n8n, ChatGPT, various AI tools



Work Setup

This is a fully remote role. You must have:

- Your own reliable laptop/desktop system

- Stable internet connection

- Professional home office setup

- Company-issued hardware is not provided.



Why Join our Company?

- Direct Founder Access — You’ll work directly with founders who value execution over bureaucracy. Your voice matters.

- High Ownership — This isn’t a “wait for instructions” role. You’ll own real business outcomes and shape how we operate.

- Remote Flexibility — Work from anywhere with flexible hours, as long as you have EST overlap for key collaborations.

- Fast-Paced Growth — We’re scaling quickly across channels. You’ll see the direct impact of your work on revenue and growth.

- Tech-Forward Culture — We embrace automation, AI, and smart systems. If you love finding better ways to work, you’ll thrive here.

- No Micromanagement — Clear expectations, full autonomy, and trust. We hire adults and treat them like adults.

title: Accounting & Invoicing Specialist (Remote Contractor)
description:
Company: Nest Marketing (DTC
 & SMS retention marketing agency)

Type: Remote contractor Reports to: Founder / Operations



We're hiring an Accounting & Invoicing Specialist to own our monthly client invoicing and day to day financial record keeping. You'll turn the end of month numbers into accurate, on time invoices across our payment platforms, keep our books clean and reconciled, and support the team's payroll. This is a detail heavy, process driven role where accuracy and reliability matter more than speed.



What you'll do

* Draft monthly client invoices in Stripe and Square using the exact amounts from the end of month report

Route each invoice to the correct platform and currency: Stripe for USD clients, Square for CAD clients, converting USD to CAD accurately where needed

* Clear old or outstanding drafts before creating the new month's invoices

* Cross reference every invoice against the client tracker, only billing clients with valid invoice dates for the current cycle

* Hold all invoices on draft until they're reviewed and approved, then send once confirmed

* Reconcile transactions against bank statements so every description and amount is recorded correctly

* Identify and correctly handle voided transactions so they're excluded from totals and reporting stays accurate

* Maintain organized, up to date financial records and expense tracking

* Support team payroll through WISE, including setup for new hires

* Flag discrepancies, missing amounts, or anything unclear before invoices go out

* Give clear status updates and notify the team promptly once each batch of drafts is ready for review





Tools you'll use

* Stripe and Square for invoicing and payments

* WISE for payroll and international transfers

* Google Sheets and Google Docs for trackers and reports

* Slack for team communication





What we're looking for

* 2+ years in bookkeeping, accounting, accounts receivable/payable, or invoicing

* Hands on experience with Stripe and Square, or the ability to get up to speed quickly

* Comfortable working across multiple currencies (USD and CAD) with accurate conversions

* Strong spreadsheet skills and comfort working from structured trackers and reports

* Sharp attention to detail with a habit of double checking your own work

* Reliable and deadline driven, especially around month end close

* A clear written communicator who gives updates without being chased

* Able to follow a defined process closely, and asks before assuming

* Discreet and trustworthy with financial and client information





Nice to have

* Experience supporting an agency or a business with many active clients

* Familiarity with WISE or similar international payroll tools

* Bank reconciliation or statement review experience

* Experience running a recurring monthly close process





Working arrangement

Remote, contractor basis

Workload concentrates around the end of each month, with lighter ongoing bookkeeping through the month

Some overlap with EST hours for reviews and hand offs



Questions:

1. Walk us through your process for a typical month-end close — from receiving the end-of-month report to sending approved invoices. How do you catch errors before they reach a client, and what's your system for cross-referencing the client tracker against invoice dates?

2. Tell us about a time you found a discrepancy — a mismatched amount, a voided transaction that wasn't excluded, a currency conversion that looked off — during reconciliation. How did you spot it, and what did you do next?

3. This role runs on Stripe, Square, and WISE across USD and CAD. What's your hands-on experience with these specific tools (or similar multi-platform/multi-currency setups), and how comfortable are you managing payroll setup for new hires in WISE?



*** HOW TO APPLY ***



*You must include your Name + Accounting & Invoicing Specialist in the subject line of your application for it to be considered (this shows you actually read it and is very important; if you do not have it in there, your application will be skipped).



1.) Send us a message answering all 3 questions

2.) Include examples of your work 



We look forward to hearing from you!

Support the drafting and roll-out of the firm's AI Use Policy and related governance documents.



IT & Cybersecurity Support

Act as the first point of contact for general IT queries and troubleshooting across the firm.



Document & Records Management

title: Video Editor DTC E-commerce | VSL, AI Video, Higgsfield, Seedance
description:
ABOUT US

We are a direct-to-consumer supplement brand selling in Australia, the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada. We advertise on
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Video ads are the most important part of our business and we produce a lot of them every week.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will edit video ads that go live in our ad accounts and are judged on how they perform. You will work from written briefs from our creative strategist, which include the angle, the script, the hook and reference ads.



WHAT YOU WILL MAKE

- VSLs and mini-VSLs (1–3 minutes) built from B-roll and sourced footage

- AI-generated ads — Pixar-style 3D animation, claymation, and explainer videos in the styles that perform on TikTok and YouTube

- UGC-style and native-style ads

- New hook variations and format variations of ads that are already winning



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 2 years editing video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands (supplements, health, beauty or wellness is a big plus)

- Hands-on experience with Higgsfield and AI video models such as Seedance, Kling, Veo or Sora

- Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or CapCut Pro at a professional standard)

- Comfortable with AI voiceover, captions, sound design and motion graphics

- A dialled-in AI workflow — you can produce animation at volume, not one clip at a time

- Reliable internet, a computer capable of video editing, and clear written English



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with advertorials, listicles and long-form native ads

- Experience editing for the US market and an American audience

- You already follow ad libraries and study what makes ads perform



HOW WE WORK

We run the company like a sports team. We measure results, not hours. If your ads perform, you get more responsibility and more pay. We expect speed, quality, constant learning, and people who care whether the work actually wins — not just whether the task was completed. We give you the outcome and let you own how you get there.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Send your application (see below)

2. Video call

3. Offer





HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS CAREFULLY

Message us with the subject line "Video Editor — [your name]".



Send us exactly two videos, both recent work:

1. One VSL — a direct-response VSL or mini-VSL for a DTC e-commerce brand, made with B-roll or sourced footage.

2. One AI video — an AI animation you made, such as a Pixar-style animation or claymation explainer.



One of each. No more.

- Send one link per video, going straight to that video.

- Do not send a folder or drive link containing many videos. If you do, we will only watch the first one. We do not have time to watch 50 videos from every applicant.

- Applicants who send more than one VSL and one AI animation will lose to the applicants who follow the instructions. This is part of how we assess you.



In your application, also tell us:

- How many minutes of animation you can produce per day working full time. Some of our editors produce 5 minutes a day with dialled-in AI workflows.

- How many minutes of VSL (B-roll and sourced footage) you can produce per day. Ours produce 2–3 minutes a day depending on complexity.

- Which AI tools and models you used on the AI video you sent.

- Your expected monthly salary.



Please be honest about your daily output — we plan your workload around it from your first week.



We reply to every complete application. Applications missing the daily output numbers will not be reviewed.

description:
Baird Built Ltd — Small Structure Design Competition

A design competition for OnlineJobs.ph — win NZD $400 + ongoing paid work

The opportunity



Baird Built Ltd (New Zealand) is looking for a talented concept designer. Submit one striking concept image, and you could win cash plus an ongoing paid design role.



Prize: NZD $400, PLUS the paid job of developing your design further, with likely ongoing paid work after that.



How it works:



Submit your concept.

We shortlist the best 4.

We post the 4 finalists on social media and the public votes — most votes wins.

What to design



A small transportable structure, under 30m², with a clear purpose — for example a sleepout, studio, guest suite, or glamping unit. Not a vague "small house": pick one specific purpose and design for it.



It should be:



Unusual and eye-catching — something that makes people stop and look twice

Purposeful — every unusual feature should have a reason, not just look cool

High-end — this is for a premium market, so use premium materials and finishes (timber shingle, slate, standing-seam metal roofing). Avoid materials like fibre-cement that read as budget in NZ.

Low maintenance — high-end doesn't mean high upkeep. Choosing durable, low-maintenance materials and details is a genuine selling point for a buyer, so factor it in alongside the look.



Here is an idea and our current top runner this will be included in the competition along with a floor plan. 
/file/d/1ew3puW7hXkE5c0IuDziAoRvjQ125w9R8/view?usp=sharing



Quick NZ tips (please read — this trips up a lot of overseas designs)

New Zealand is in the Southern Hemisphere — the sun comes from the north, not the south. Put your main windows and living space facing north.

NZ is cold, not tropical — insulate well and use double glazing.

NZ had a "leaky homes" crisis — keep roof overhangs and cladding details simple and well-drained, complex high risk claddings can be a negative (our current image is high risk but we will let the public vote on that).

We can transport up to 4.5m wide and 3.6m high — bigger than a standard load, so feel free to think big. Multiple bolted-together modules are welcome too.

What to submit



Just one marketable concept image (render, sketch, or similar), a simple floor plan, plus a couple of sentences on the purpose, what makes it unusual, and why it's low-maintenance.

title: TikTok Video Editor
description:
TikTok Shop Video Editor – High-Volume Product Content



I’m looking for a reliable, experienced video editor to handle the editing of my TikTok Shop product videos on an ongoing basis.



I am a full-time TikTok Shop affiliate creator producing a high volume of product-focused content, primarily in the tech, electronics, tools, home, automotive, and gadget categories.



What I Need



I typically shoot 10 short-form product videos per day. This is a high-volume position and will generally involve editing approximately 10 videos per day, or around 300 videos per month. However if this goes well that number could go up to 10 to 30 videos per day.



There may occasionally be days with fewer videos, but applicants should assume that 10 videos per day is the normal workload and make sure they have the availability and editing capacity to handle that consistently.



I will provide the raw footage, and I need an editor who can take each video from raw footage to a finished, ready-to-post TikTok.



The goal is NOT heavily produced or cinematic content. These are direct-response TikTok Shop videos designed to hold attention and sell products while still feeling natural and authentic.



You will be responsible for:



- Editing approximately 10 short-form videos per day

- Cutting out pauses, mistakes, dead space, repeated takes, and unnecessary footage

- Keeping the pacing fast without making the video feel unnaturally over-edited

- Identifying and preserving the strongest hook at the beginning

- Keeping the video moving smoothly from hook ? product demonstration/explanation ? benefits ? call to action

- Adding clean, readable on-screen captions/subtitles

- Adding text overlays when they help emphasize an important feature, benefit, or statement

- Using punch-ins, zooms, cuts, B-roll, or other simple editing techniques when appropriate to maintain viewer attention

- Cleaning up and balancing audio when necessary

- Delivering videos formatted correctly for vertical 9:16 TikTok content

- Exporting finished videos in high quality and ready for me to upload



The Editing Style



My content is primarily me speaking directly to the camera while demonstrating a product.



I do NOT want every video filled with unnecessary effects, transitions, memes, sound effects, or distracting graphics.



The editor should understand that with TikTok Shop, retention and conversions matter more than flashy editing.



The ideal finished video should grab attention immediately, remove anything that slows the video down, feel conversational and authentic, clearly demonstrate the product, emphasize the important selling points, maintain viewer attention, and end cleanly with the call to action.



Most videos will be approximately 30–90 seconds, although length may vary depending on the product.



What I'm Looking For



I’m looking for someone who:



- Has experience editing TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, UGC, or direct-response product videos

- Ideally has experience with TikTok Shop or e-commerce content

- Understands hooks, retention, pacing, and short-form viewer behavior

- Can make editing decisions independently rather than requiring detailed instructions for every video

- Has the capacity to consistently handle approximately 10 videos every day

- Has fast turnaround times

- Communicates reliably

- Can learn my editing style and become increasingly independent over time



I don't want to have to tell you where every cut should go.



I want to be able to upload my raw footage, provide basic information when necessary, and trust you to turn it into a finished video that matches my style.



Long-Term Opportunity



This is not a one-time project. I am looking for someone who can become my regular long-term editor.



Because I create approximately 10 videos every day, this can provide a large and consistent volume of ongoing paid work for the right editor.



As you learn my style, I want the process to become extremely streamlined:



I shoot ? upload raw footage ? you edit ? I review ? video is ready to post.



Ultimately, my goal is to spend my time shooting and creating more content instead of sitting at my computer editing videos.



When Applying



Please send:



1. Examples of short-form videos you have personally edited

2. Any examples of TikTok Shop, UGC, product, or e-commerce videos you've edited

3. Your typical turnaround time

4. Confirmation that you can consistently handle approximately 10 videos per day

5. Your pricing — preferably your per-video rate and/or monthly rate for approximately 300 videos per month

6. What editing software you use



Please start your application with the words “TIKTOK EDITOR” so I know you actually read the entire posting.

title: Lead Generation & Data Research Specialist
description:
Lead Generation & Data Research Specialist

Apollo | ZoomInfo | Web Research | List Building | Data Quality

Company: Purnell & Company, Inc.

Position: Lead Generation & Data Research Specialist

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

Schedule: 8

Compensation: $4 - $5 weekly



About the Role

Purnell & Company is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Lead Generation & Data

Research Specialist to support our growing sales and business development operations.

This is not a cold-calling position.

Your primary responsibility will be finding, researching, organizing, verifying, and maintaining

high-quality prospect data that our sales teams can use.

You will work with tools such as Apollo, ZoomInfo, company websites, federal agency

websites, online directories, and manual web research to build targeted prospect lists based

on specific criteria.

We are looking for someone who enjoys research, works quickly without sacrificing accuracy,

follows processes carefully, and can manage large amounts of data without losing track of

where work stopped.



What You Will Do

Lead Generation & Research

• Build targeted prospect lists based on specific campaign criteria.

• Research companies, organizations, federal agencies, and individual contacts.

• Identify decision-makers based on job title, department, seniority, geography, company

size, and other assigned criteria.

• Find and compile contact information including:

o First and last name

o Company or organization

o Job title

o Business

o Phone number

o LinkedIn profile



Geographic location

o Department or seniority

o Source information

o Other campaign-specific information



Research Using Multiple Sources

You may use:

• Apollo

• ZoomInfo

• Federal agency websites

• Company websites

• Business directories

• LinkedIn

• Manual Google/web research

• Other approved research databases and sources

Some projects will involve high-volume database extraction. Others will require detailed

manual research to locate difficult-to-find contacts.

Data Quality & Accuracy

Generating large numbers of leads is not enough.

You will be responsible for ensuring that the information you collect is accurate, organized, and

usable.



You will:

• Verify that contacts meet assigned targeting criteria.

• Confirm required data fields are completed.

• Spot-check records for accuracy.

• Identify and remove obviously incomplete or unqualified records.

• Maintain consistent formatting.

• Prevent duplicate records whenever possible.

• Flag questionable or uncertain duplicates.

• Avoid repeating research that has already been completed.



Quality is more important than inflating lead counts with bad data.



Daily Workflow

At the beginning of each workday you will:

Review the previous day’s End-of-Day report.

2. Identify the exact project and campaign being worked.

3. Determine where research stopped.

4. Confirm the current targeting criteria.

5. Continue from the previous stopping point instead of starting over.

6. Determine the appropriate research method for the assignment.

7. Establish the day’s production target based on the type and complexity of the project.



During your shift, you will track:

• Leads generated

• Leads verified

• Leads rejected or excluded when applicable

• Current project or source

• Current stopping point

• Research or productivity blockers

• Tool or access issues

• Changes to campaign criteria



Production Expectations

Production requirements depend on the type of assignment.

Current working benchmarks include:



Manual research:

Approximately 500 completed leads during a full production day, depending on the complexity

of the research and number of required fields.



Scalable database or extraction projects:

Approximately 6,000–8,000 records during a full production day, depending on the platform,

targeting criteria, extraction difficulty, and verification requirements.



These are benchmarks—not universal quotas.

We evaluate performance based on a combination of:

• Production volume

• Accuracy

• Data quality

• Duplicate control

• Ability to follow campaign criteria

• Organization

• Workflow continuity



Communication

End-of-Day Reporting

Every workday must end with a clear EOD report.



Your report should show:

Project

• Campaign/project name

• Source

• Targeting criteria

• Agency/company/segment being researched



Production

• Leads generated

• Leads verified or rejected when applicable

• Cumulative totals



Progress

• Starting point

• Ending point

• Remaining work

• Exact starting point for the next work session



Quality

• Duplicate issues

• Missing information

• Data-quality concerns



Blockers

• Platform problems

• Access problems

• Research limitations

• Questions regarding targeting criteria



Your manager should be able to read your EOD report and immediately understand what was

completed, where you stopped, and exactly what should happen next.



You Must Be Comfortable Asking Questions

We do not want someone who blindly produces incorrect data.

You are expected to notify management when:

• Lead criteria are unclear.

• Instructions conflict.

• Required information cannot be located.

• A research platform is unavailable.

• Duplicate rates appear unusually high.

• Production is significantly below expectations.

• Source data appears unreliable.

• An assigned list has been completed.

• You identify a better way to improve speed, accuracy, or quality.



We value people who can follow systems and improve systems.

Ideal Candidate

You may be a strong fit if you:

• Are extremely detail-oriented.

• Enjoy internet research and data collection.

• Can work independently for long periods without losing focus.

• Are comfortable handling thousands of records.

• Understand the importance of clean data.

• Can follow detailed written SOPs.

• Keep accurate notes about your progress.

• Have strong organizational skills.

• Can recognize inconsistencies and questionable data.

• Are comfortable working with changing campaign requirements.

• Communicate problems instead of hiding them.

• Can move quickly while maintaining accuracy.

• Take ownership of completing assignments.



Preferred Experience

Experience with one or more of the following is highly preferred:

• Apollo

• ZoomInfo

• LinkedIn research

• Lead generation

• Contact research

• Data enrichment

List building

• B2B prospect research

• Federal government or agency research

• Large database projects

• Data verification

• Duplicate management



You do not need insurance experience to succeed in this role.

We are more interested in your ability to research, organize information, follow instructions,

maintain data quality, and consistently produce results.

What Success Looks Like



The right person for this position becomes someone our sales organization can depend on.

You consistently provide:

• Accurate prospect data

• Organized lists

• Reliable production

• Minimal unnecessary duplicates

• Clear documentation

• Strong daily communication

• Complete EOD reports

• Continuous progress from one workday to the next



When handed a research project, you should be able to understand the assignment, establish

an efficient research process, execute it, document your progress, and continue until the

project is complete.



HOW TO APPLY

We are specifically looking for candidates who pay attention to details.

Please include the word PRECISION at the beginning of your application.

Then answer the following questions:

1. How many years of lead generation, internet research, or data research experience do

you have?

2. Which of these tools have you personally used: Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, Google

Search, or other lead-generation databases?

Describe a project where you had to research and organize a large number of contacts

or companies. Approximately how many records were involved?

4. How do you prevent duplicate leads when working on a large research project?

5. If you were assigned 5,000 companies to research over several days, explain how you

would document your stopping point so another person could immediately continue

your work.

6. What steps would you take if the instructions for a lead-generation project were

unclear?

7. How do you balance speed with data accuracy?

8. What is your current internet speed and computer setup?

9. What hours are you available to work?

10. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time position?



Practical Test



Candidates who advance may receive a short paid or unpaid skills assessment involving

prospect research, data organization, duplicate identification, and following written

instructions.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our operations team,

take ownership of their work, and help us continuously improve the way we generate and

manage prospect data.

title: Property Analyst with AI Skill
description:
We are looking for a Property Analyst with strong AI and data analytics skills to join our real estate team.



The role combines Singapore property market research, data analysis, AI tools and strategic insights. You will be responsible for turning large amounts of property data into clear, practical insights that can support property investment decisions, client presentations and marketing strategies.



The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in the Singapore property market and be comfortable using AI tools, data analytics and automation to improve the speed and quality of research.



Key Responsibilities

1. Property Market Research

Conduct research on the Singapore residential property market.

Analyse HDB, condominium, EC and landed property markets.

Track new launches, resale transactions, rental trends and price movements.

Research developers, projects, land sales and URA planning developments.

Monitor major market trends, government policies and property regulations.

Identify emerging growth areas and potential investment opportunities.



2. Property Data Analysis

Collect, clean and organise property data from various sources.

Analyse:

Transaction prices

PSF trends

Rental yields

Capital appreciation

Take-up rates

New launch performance

HDB resale prices

MRT accessibility

School proximity

District and planning trends

Build databases to compare properties and developments.

Identify patterns and relationships that may not be obvious from raw data.



3. AI & Automation

Use AI tools to speed up property research and analysis.

Develop AI-assisted workflows for:

Property research

Data collection

Market analysis

Report generation

Competitor analysis

Lead profiling

Content creation

Explore and implement AI tools that can improve the team's productivity.

Use AI to summarise large amounts of property information into actionable insights.

Assist in developing AI-powered property analysis tools and internal databases.

Automate repetitive research and reporting processes where possible.



4. Investment & Asset Progression Analysis

Analyse property scenarios for different buyer profiles.

Conduct comparisons between:

HDB vs private property

Resale vs new launch

Freehold vs leasehold

OCR vs RCR vs CCR

Different property sizes and locations

Support analysis on asset progression and retirement planning.

Develop financial and property models to assess potential upgrading strategies.

Identify potential risks and opportunities associated with different property strategies.



5. Market Reports & Presentation

Prepare easy-to-understand property market reports.

Convert complex data into simple charts, tables and visual presentations.

Prepare research materials for client presentations and seminars.

Provide data-backed insights for social media and educational content.

Support the team with facts, statistics and market evidence for property presentations.



6. Property Intelligence Database

Build and maintain a comprehensive Singapore property database.

Track historical and current information on:

Developments

Developers

Transactions

Launch prices

Land prices

Rental prices

MRT distances

Schools

Government land sales

Future developments

Continuously improve the database to support long-term market analysis.



Requirements

Essential

Diploma/Degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Business, Data Analytics, Computer Science or related fields.

Strong interest in the Singapore property market.

Strong analytical and research skills.

Good Excel/Google Sheets skills.

Ability to interpret property and financial data.

Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT and other AI platforms.

Strong attention to detail.

Good written and communication skills.

Preferred

Experience in Singapore real estate research or property analysis.

Knowledge of URA, HDB, SLA, MAS and Singapore property regulations.

Experience with data visualisation tools.

Experience with Python, SQL, Power BI or similar analytics tools.

Experience with web scraping or data automation.

Experience building databases.

Familiarity with AI automation and API integrations.

Experience analysing large datasets.

AI Skills Expected



The successful candidate should be able to use AI beyond simple prompting.



You should be able to:



Build effective AI research workflows.

Use AI to analyse property datasets.

Create structured prompts for property research.

Automate repetitive research tasks.

Use AI for data cleaning and categorisation.

Generate market reports using AI-assisted workflows.

Experiment with different AI platforms and identify useful applications.

Work with developers or AI engineers to improve internal AI systems.



Strong AI capability will be considered a major advantage.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be measured based on:



Accuracy and quality of property research.

Speed of completing market analysis.

Quality of property databases maintained.

Number of useful market insights generated.

Effectiveness of AI automation implemented.

Reduction in manual research time.

Quality of reports and presentations produced.

Ability to identify meaningful property trends.

Contribution to investment and asset-progression strategies.

Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



Analytical + Curious + Tech-Savvy + Property-Focused



You should enjoy asking:



"What does the data tell us that other property agents are not seeing?"



The ideal candidate is not simply someone who collects property information. You should be able to connect the data, identify patterns and turn those findings into practical property strategies.



Interested applicants can send in their resume with
 or Whatsapp Contact number

title: Documentary YouTube Producer / Video Editor – Potential Long-Term Opportunity
description:
I’m starting a faceless YouTube documentary channel called The Money Alibi focused on unbelievable true stories involving money, scams, fraud, corporate deception, rigged systems, and major financial schemes.



An example of the type of video we would produce:



“The Man Who Rigged McDonald’s Monopoly for Years”



Videos will generally be 10–15 minutes long and should feel like professional, entertaining mini-documentaries rather than generic “YouTube automation” videos.



What I’m Looking For



Ideally, I want someone who can take a topic or general video idea and handle most or all of the production process:



* Research the true story using reliable sources

* Fact-check important claims

* Write an engaging YouTube script

* Create or arrange voiceover/narration

* Source relevant footage, photographs, documents, headlines, etc.

* Create motion graphics/animations when appropriate

* Add music and sound design

* Edit the complete video

* Deliver an upload-ready finished video



Strong storytelling and viewer retention are very important. The first 30–60 seconds should hook the viewer, and the video should remain visually interesting throughout.



Copyright & Monetization



Everything used in the finished video must be appropriate for commercial YouTube use and monetization.



Footage, photographs, music, sound effects, graphics, and other assets must be properly licensed, public domain, original, or otherwise legally usable.



I want to avoid copyright claims, copyright strikes, and reused-content monetization problems.



Style



I’m looking for someone with experience in areas such as:



* Documentary filmmaking

* YouTube documentaries

* Visual storytelling

* Motion graphics

* Video editing

* Research-based content



I am not looking for low-quality AI-generated videos consisting of random stock footage over an AI voice.



I want these videos to feel like genuine mini-documentaries that someone would enjoy watching even if they had never heard of the story before.



First Project



The first project will be one paid test video approximately 10–15 minutes long.



If the quality and working relationship are good, this can become consistent long-term work producing additional videos for the channel.



When Applying



Please include:



1. 2–3 examples of your work that are closest to this documentary style.

2. Whether you can handle the entire process from topic ? research ? script ? narration ? visuals ? editing.

3. Which parts of the process, if any, you would need me to provide.

4. Approximately how many hours you would expect a 10–15 minute documentary to take.

5. Your hourly rate.

6. Where you normally source footage, photos, music, and other assets for monetized YouTube videos.



Please start your application with the words “Money Alibi” so I know you read the full posting.



I’m looking to build a long-term relationship with the right person rather than hire someone for only one video.

About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Growth & Marketing Lead who can take ownership of marketing and growth for Autonomous AI while also helping our clients grow.



This is not a role for someone who simply waits for marketing tasks.



We need someone who can:



Research ? Strategise ? Plan ? Execute ? Measure ? Improve



You will research markets and competitors, identify opportunities, develop marketing strategies and present major recommendations to the Founder for approval.

title: Remote Legal Assistant – U.S. Law Firm – Part-Time / Flexible Hours
description:
U.S.-based law firm is seeking a dependable, organized, and proactive Remote Legal Assistant / Virtual Assistant for ongoing part-time work.



This is not a fixed-schedule position. I divide my time between Italy and Los Angeles, so working hours vary. At times, assignments and communication will occur during Italy business hours, and at other times during Los Angeles business hours. title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
*** Please read through the entire post before applying.  Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want motion graphics video work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will be our primary creator for explainer and motion graphics videos, and the internal design resource that keeps every project sharp, from animated explainers to the diagrams, callouts, and overlays our editors rely on. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need a designer who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.

Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



This is a dual-focus role. You are the primary creator for our explainer and motion graphics videos, and you also produce graphic assets for our standard video team when needed. You will coordinate with our editors to supply the graphic elements, overlays, and design assets each project needs.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Motion Graphics: Lead the production of full explainer videos, from storyboarding and asset creation to final animation.



Collaborative Design: Act as the internal design resource for our video editors. You will build the lower thirds, callouts, and technical diagrams their edits need.



Web and Digital Assets: Design high-fidelity web page elements and marketing collateral that fit our brand and our clients' technical standards.



Brand Consistency: Hold a high level of quality across every visual touchpoint, with a clean, professional, and sophisticated look.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Technical Stack: Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop, or similar motion and design software.



Portfolio: A strong reel of explainer and motion graphics work, plus a portfolio of clean, functional graphic design (web elements, technical icons, diagrams).



Coordination: You can work alongside editors and give them the assets they need to hit their timelines.

Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- 3D motion or design (Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar)

- Technical illustration or data and diagram visualization

- Brand and identity design

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $10.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,600 USD per month (about 39,000 to 98,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $800 USD per month (about 20,000 to 49,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Motivated Motion Graphics Artist - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best motion and static design work. No portfolio means no consideration.

- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe a specific time you had to fix a mistake you made in a motion graphics project. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest!

description:

MUST ACCEPT BITCOIN PAYMENTS



The Work:



You’ll create 3 thumbnail variations per video, with a minimum of 1 video per week.



Minimum workload: 3 thumbnails per week / 12+ per month.



Our thumbnails generally include:



* 2 people/faces

* Short, bold text overlays

* A background relevant to the video topic

* Strong composition and clear focal points

* Professional cut-outs, lighting, shadows and colour grading

* Different concepts suitable for YouTube A/B testing



Natural-Looking Faces — Important



We do not want AI-looking or heavily edited faces.



Faces should look hyper-realistic and naturally enhanced, not altered.



You can improve lighting, sharpness, contrast and colour, but the person should still look like themselves. Real skin texture should remain.

CTR & Colour Theory is IMPORTANT



You should understand YouTube CTR (Click-Through Rate) and what makes someone stop scrolling and click.



We’re looking for someone who understands:



* Thumbnail psychology and creating curiosity

* Bold, readable text

* Strong visual hierarchy

* Colour theory and complementary colours

* Using contrast to make subjects stand out

* Natural but professional colour grading

* Designing for mobile

* Creating genuinely different thumbnails for A/B testing



What We’re Looking For



* Experience creating YouTube thumbnails

* Strong Photoshop or equivalent skills

* Understanding of CTR and A/B testing

* Strong understanding of colour theory

* Ability to enhance faces without making them look AI-generated

* Reliable weekly turnaround

* Comfortable with feedback and revisions

* A strong portfolio of previous thumbnail work



There is a minimum of 1 video per week (3 thumbnails), with the opportunity for more ongoing work.

Applications without “SATOSHI” will not be considered.



Please include examples of your best YouTube thumbnails, especially thumbnails featuring people/faces.

title: Amazon Wholesale VA - Brand Sourcing, Cold Calling & Ungating
description:
We are a US-registered wholesale distribution company sourcing branded products for Amazon FBA. We are looking for an experienced Virtual Assistant to own the front end of our wholesale funnel: finding the right brands, getting through to decision makers, and managing those brand relationships once they are live.

 

This is not an entry level role. We are only considering candidates who have already done this work for another Amazon wholesale seller.

 

THE TARGET

Deliver 2 to 3 qualified brands per month. A qualified brand means: the right decision maker reached, genuine interest confirmed, price list received, and products profitable at our ROI threshold.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

1. Brand and product research

- Build the brand list yourself using TPP, SmartScout, Keepa and Seller Amp, based on agreed filter criteria (FBA seller count, dominant seller share, revenue range)

- Identify authorised US distributors using ImportYeti, USPTO and brand websites

- Analyse profitability: buy cost, Amazon fees, ROI and margin

- Screen out gated, IP-risk and Amazon-dominated brands before outreach

 

2. Contact sourcing and outreach

- Find direct decision maker contacts using tools such as Apollo, RocketReach, Hunter, Seamless, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or ZoomInfo

- Reach purchasing, national accounts or sales managers directly, not reception or a generic 

- Send wholesale enquiry
s and follow up on a set schedule

- Make outbound cold calls during US business hours using your own proven approach, and handle objections

- Request price lists, MOQ, payment terms and lead times, and pass everything to us with a clean summary

 

3. Account management

- Maintain ongoing relationships with our existing brands and distributors

- Monitor price list updates, promotions, MOQ changes and stock availability

- Chase quotes, order confirmations, shipping updates and missing paperwork

- Flag pricing changes that affect our margin

- Keep every brand record current: contact, terms, pricing, order process

 

4. Tracking and reporting

- Log every contact, call and follow-up in our tracking sheet

- Weekly report: brands contacted, connect rate, price lists received, qualified brands delivered, open items on existing accounts

 

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Minimum 2 years hands-on experience with Amazon wholesale sourcing and brand outreach

- Confident spoken English, comfortable cold calling US brand owners and purchasing managers

- Skilled with SmartScout, Keepa and Seller Amp

- Skilled with contact sourcing tools (Apollo, RocketReach, Hunter, Seamless, Sales Navigator or similar)

- Strong Google Sheets or Excel: filtering, lookups, profitability formulas, clean tracking

- Organised follow-up habits, nothing falls through the cracks

- Reliable internet and a quiet space for calls

- Must overlap with US business hours (9am to 5pm EST)

- 20 hours per week, 80 hours per month, ongoing

 

WHAT WE PROVIDE

Phone number,
 templates and tool access. You will not be paying for anything out of pocket. If you need anything further during the role, such as AI tools, subscriptions or extra software, just let us know and we will look at it.

 

You are expected to bring your own calling approach, we do not hand out scripts. You will be the one calling and dealing with brands and distributors directly, so you need to be comfortable running those conversations on your own.

 

TRIAL AND GROWTH

Salary is USD 350 to 650 per month depending on your experience and track record. Tell us what you are looking for and back it up with results.



Paid 1 month trial, because a wholesale funnel takes weeks to produce a result, not days. We assess on the full pipeline, not just the final outcome. After the trial this becomes an ongoing role, with a performance bonus on top of your base rate for strong results.

 

We are early stage, so you get to build the full funnel with us rather than inherit someone else's system: your own research criteria, your own outreach approach, your own tracking and process. If you have wanted ownership over how a wholesale operation is actually run, this is that role. Real growth path: strong performers take on more of the Amazon account over time.

 

TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER

1. Which brands have you personally done wholesale outreach for?

2. Which categories have you worked in, and what results did you get?

3. Which research and contact sourcing tools do you use?

4. Fun one: if a brand owner picks up the phone and says "we don't sell on Amazon", what's your comeback? One line is fine.

 

Attach your CV or share your portfolio if you have one, optional.

 

Please start your message with the word MANGO so we know you read the full ad.

title: Advanced SEO and Online Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Elite-level Internet Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist with proven experience handling difficult and high-profile online reputation cases. We work with high-profile individuals, including celebrities, executives, public figures, and brands, and we need someone who understands how to handle reputation issues that can spread rapidly across the internet.



This is not a traditional SEO or social media position.

We are looking for someone experienced in advanced content removal, search suppression, de-indexing, takedown coordination, and reputation recovery.



To give you a better understanding of the type of cases we handle:

Imagine a high-profile celebrity such as Beyoncé has an embarrassing incident during a live performance. Someone records the incident, uploads the video, and within hours the footage is being reposted across Google, social media, news websites, and other platforms. We are looking for a specialist who understands how to approach a situation like this and legitimately pursue removal of the original and replicated content wherever possible, while also addressing the resulting search visibility. This is the level of complexity and urgency we are looking for—not simply removing a negative review or improving a Google ranking.



Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute advanced ORM strategies

- Identify the source and spread of damaging content

- Pursue legitimate content removal and takedown opportunities

- Evaluate available Google and platform removal processes

- Develop search-suppression strategies when removal is not possible

- Coordinate with publishers, platforms, and legal counsel when appropriate

- Develop authoritative content to strengthen positive search results

- Monitor Google rankings, indexing, and search visibility

- Provide regular reports and recommendations



Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred:

- Advanced Online Reputation Management

- Viral or high-profile content removal

- Search-result suppression

- Google de-indexing and removal processes

- Website and platform takedowns

- Legal/policy-based removal requests

- Technical SEO

- High-authority content publishing

- Reputation management for celebrities, executives, or public figures

- Complex cases involving news websites, social platforms, government websites, court records, or other authoritative sources



We are not looking for someone who only has basic SEO, backlink building, keyword research, or Google review management experience. We need someone who has actually handled complex ORM cases and can demonstrate real results.

 and provide:

description:
# Customer Service Representative — Shopify Dropshipping 
 Support)



We run multiple Shopify dropshipping stores in Europe and are looking for a reliable Customer Service Representative to join our customer support team.



This is an
 support role. You will handle customer
s, use our templates and workflows, log refunds in Google Sheets, and escalate complex cases when needed.



You MUST already have experience with customer service for dropshipping stores. Experience handling support for multiple stores at the same time is a big advantage.



---



## Main Responsibilities



* Answer customer
s for Shopify dropshipping stores

* Maintain a steady pace of around **20 answered
s per hour**

* Handle order questions, shipping updates, returns, refunds, lost packages, and defective product claims

* Use DeepL to translate Dutch, Polish, and other European customer
s

* Start from the correct pre-written template, but personalize every single reply — customers should never receive an obvious copy-paste answer

* Build and improve your own ChatGPT prompt/template so each
 is written specifically for that customer and their situation

* Handle refund requests using our step-by-step compensation ladder and keep the overall refund percentage as low as possible

* Keep customers calm and satisfied to reduce disputes and escalations

* Log refunds and important cases in Google Sheets

* Check supplier/order information when needed

* Escalate unclear, aggressive, or complex cases through Slack

* Coordinate with another CS team member so work is divided properly



---



## Refunds & Resolution Ladder



Refunds have a direct impact on our margins, so an important part of this role is solving problems properly instead of handing out money by default.



We work with a fixed ladder. You always start at the lowest step:



1. **20% partial refund** — the standard first offer

2. **40% partial refund** — only if the customer declines the first offer and the case justifies it

3. **60% partial refund** — final step, only for serious cases

4. **Return to our supplier in China** — the alternative if the customer does not accept a partial refund



Do not skip steps. Never jump to a higher percentage just because it is faster or easier, and never issue a full refund on your own — those cases go to Slack first.



Every offer must be explained in a friendly, personalized message so the customer feels heard and accepts the solution instead of opening a dispute or chargeback.



---



## Requirements



* Must have experience with CS for Shopify dropshipping stores

* Experience supporting multiple stores is preferred

* Excellent written English

* Strong attention to detail

* Able to follow workflows and templates exactly

* Confident handling refund negotiations and sticking to the compensation ladder

* Able to work at a fast, consistent pace (around 20
s per hour)

* Calm, professional tone with customers

* Comfortable using Gmail, Google Sheets, DeepL, Slack, and ChatGPT

* Comfortable running Hubstaff time tracking during your shifts

* Reliable internet and availability 6 days per week

* Able to work in a coordinated schedule with another CS team member



---



## Performance & Tracking



* We expect around **20
s answered per hour**. With templates, DeepL, and our documented workflows this is very achievable once you know the system.

* Working hours are tracked with **Hubstaff**, which records time and activity during your shift. Hubstaff only runs while you are clocked in on your shift.

* We also look at your **refund rate**: how many cases you manage to resolve at the lowest possible step of the ladder.

* Speed matters, but quality matters too. Wrong or careless replies create disputes, so accuracy comes first.



---



## Languages



You do not need to speak Dutch or other European languages.



We use DeepL, pre-written templates, and documented workflows. You need strong English and the ability to understand the customer issue correctly after translation.



---



## Hours & Compensation



* Part-time to start

* Around 12–18 hours per week

* **Around 2–3 hours per day, 6 days per week**

* More hours possible as workload grows

* **Rate: $4 per hour**

* Payment: weekly via Wise, based on the hours tracked in Hubstaff



The schedule is not fully random/flexible. You will work together with another CS team member, so hours need to be coordinated to avoid overlap and make sure
s are covered properly.



---



## Important



When you start your session, the assigned inbox must be cleared properly. Customer
s should not be left unanswered without a clear reason or escalation.



We are looking for someone reliable, consistent, and long-term.



---



## How To Apply



Please reply with:



1. The word **LIGHTHOUSE** in the subject of your application

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. Your experience with Shopify dropshipping customer service

4. Whether you have handled CS for multiple stores at the same time (include store names / links)

5. Which tools you have used before: Gmail, Shopify, Google Sheets, Slack, DeepL, ChatGPT, Hubstaff, etc.

6. Your time zone and daily availability

7. When you can start

8. A short answer to this question: a customer writes that their product arrived damaged and demands a full refund. How do you handle it?

9. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the $4/hour rate and the 20
s per hour target

10. A screenshot of your internet speed test from speedtest.net



Applications without dropshipping CS experience will not be considered.



Looking forward to working together long-term!

title: Canva eBook Designer Needed ASAP – Complete Existing eBook
description:
Hi!



I'm looking for an experienced Canva eBook / Editorial Designer who can start immediately and help me complete an eBook that is already fully written.



This is NOT an eBook writing project.



The entire manuscript is already finished.



I also already have a finalized or nearly finalized:



Cover design

Table of contents design

Overall visual direction

Brand/style reference



Your job is to take this existing design direction and turn the full manuscript into a polished, professional, and highly readable eBook in Canva.



Important: Fast Turnaround



I would like to complete the entire eBook by this weekend so I can begin selling it immediately.



Please apply only if you:



Can start immediately

Have significant availability over the next few days

Can communicate quickly

Are confident you can meet a tight deadline



Speed is important, but quality and readability are equally important.



About the eBook



The book is about Korean culture, Korean thinking, relationships, dating, family, school, work culture, and communication.



The target audience is foreigners who are interested in Korea and want to understand Korean people and culture better.



The book has 8 chapters, and all written content is already complete.



I will provide:



Full manuscript

Existing Canva design

Cover design

Table of contents

Design references

Brand direction

Feedback during the project



You do NOT need to write the content.



Your main responsibility is turning the manuscript into a beautiful and easy-to-read digital book.



Design Direction



The eBook should NOT feel like a traditional textbook.



I want it to feel like a:



Modern + Clean + Friendly + Easy-to-Read Korean Culture Guide



Imagine someone reading this casually during a flight to Korea.



It should feel premium, but not overly formal.



The design should support the writing—not distract from it.



Readability is extremely important.



Your Responsibilities



You will:



Design and format Chapters 1–8 in Canva

Create a consistent layout system throughout the book

Break long text into readable sections

Create clear visual hierarchy

Design chapter opening pages

Design section headings

Format body text

Format quotes and highlighted information

Create callout boxes when appropriate

Create layouts for tips, cultural explanations, and key takeaways

Use whitespace effectively

Maintain consistent typography, spacing, and visual style

Add simple visual elements when they improve the reading experience

Make sure the entire book feels like one consistent product

Deliver a fully editable Canva file

Deliver the final PDF ready for digital sale



You should be able to look at written content and d
:



"How can I make this information easier and more enjoyable to read?"



I'm not looking for someone who simply copies and pastes text into Canva.



I'm looking for someone with strong editorial layout and information design skills.



Requirements



You MUST have:



Strong Canva skills

Previous eBook, workbook, magazine, guide, or multi-page PDF design experience

Strong typography skills

Good understanding of spacing and visual hierarchy

Ability to create clean and readable page layouts

Strong attention to detail

Good English comprehension

Ability to follow an existing design direction

Fast communication

Ability to meet deadlines

Portfolio Required



Please send examples of previous:



eBooks

Workbooks

Guides

Magazines

Reports

Multi-page PDF designs



Please show INTERIOR pages, not only book covers.



This is very important.



Project Workflow



Because we are working on a tight deadline, I do NOT want to spend several days doing separate design tests.



Instead:



Step 1



I will review your portfolio and previous eBook work.



Step 2



If selected, you will start immediately with Chapter 1.



Step 3



You will send me the first few pages / Chapter 1 design direction for review.



Step 4



I will provide fast feedback.



Step 5



Once the design direction is approved, you will apply the system consistently across Chapters 2–8.



Step 6



We will complete a final review and export the finished eBook.



This allows us to move quickly while still making sure the design direction is correct.



Budget



Fixed Project Budget: $150–$250 USD



Final rate depends on:



Portfolio quality

Experience

Speed

Estimated completion time



For an excellent designer who can deliver high-quality work very quickly, I'm open to discussing the budget.



To Apply



Please send:



Your portfolio

At least 2 examples of eBooks, workbooks, or multi-page layouts you personally designed

Your fixed-price quote for this project

When you can start

Your estimated turnaround time

How many hours you can work over the next few days



Please start your application with:



KOREAN DECODER



so I know you read the entire job description.



I'm hiring quickly and would like to start as soon as possible.



If you're a strong designer who works fast and enjoys creating beautiful digital products, I'd love to work with you.

title: Video Editor — Nature & Travel Documentaries, Long-Term Role
Email Marketing
description:
Community Growth & Lead Generation Specialist



Remote | Philippines | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity



The Hygienist Bar is changing the conversation around oral health.



We believe the mouth shouldn't be treated as something separate from the rest of the body. We focus on the environment teeth and gums live in—including gum health, saliva, bacteria, the oral microbiome, inflammation, and prevention.



We're looking for someone who can do much more than generate a list of names.



We need a curious researcher, communicator, and relationship builder who can learn our philosophy, understand why oral health matters, find people already asking questions about it, and join those conversations intelligently.



This is NOT a high-volume cold-calling position.



What You'll Do



Research gum health, saliva, the oral microbiome, preventive oral health, and the relationship between oral and overall health.



Find people online who are already asking questions about bleeding gums, gum disease, bad breath, oral bacteria, dental anxiety, oral microbiome, and preventive health.



Research their questions before responding.



Provide helpful, educational answers based on credible sources—never diagnose or give medical advice.



Identify conversations where The Hygienist Bar could genuinely help.



Build relationships with potential guests rather than immediately trying to sell them.



Identify local wellness businesses and potential referral partners.



Research functional medicine, longevity, fitness, wellness, and health professionals who align with our philosophy.



Find relevant influencers, creators, podcasts, organizations, and community partners.



Follow up with existing THB leads and inquiries.



Help interested people move naturally from education ? conversation ? appointment.



Track every lead, conversation, follow-up, and appointment in our CRM/Google Sheets.



The Person We're Looking For



You are naturally curious.



When someone asks:



“Why do my gums bleed?”



You don't immediately try to sell them something.



You research the question.



You understand what credible sources say.



You learn enough to have an intelligent conversation.



And you know when the appropriate answer is to recommend seeing a licensed healthcare professional.



That's the mindset we're looking for.



Excellent spoken and written English is essential.



Experience in dental, medical, wellness, fitness, healthcare marketing, research, community management, or appointment setting is a major advantage.



APPLICATION TEST — IMPORTANT



Please do not send us a generic application.



Before applying, spend some time researching gum health and oral-systemic health.



Then answer this question in your own words:



Why does gum health matter beyond simply keeping your teeth?



Imagine someone on 
 or
 asked you that question.



Write the response you would give them.



Please tell us:



1. Why gum health matters



2. What you've learned about the relationship between oral health and overall health



3. Two credible sources you used to research your answer



4. How you would answer the person without sounding like you're selling them something



Then send us a 60–90 second video introducing yourself and explaining one thing you discovered during your research that surprised you.



We are not looking for the person who already knows everything about oral health.



We're looking for the person who knows how to learn, research, communicate, and become genuinely passionate about what we're building.



Compensation



$4–$6 USD/hour to start + performance bonuses



Approximately 20–25 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a much larger role.



The Hygienist Bar



We don't just clean teeth. We pay attention to the environment they live in.

title: Revit Families BIM Modeler (Remote)
description:

Employment Type: Full-Time Freelance

Location: Remote 



RD Studio is an international BIM content company known for high-quality Revit families used by thousands of architects worldwide. We are expanding our team and looking for a Revit Family Modeler who specializes in complex, highly parametric content.



(Note: We are specifically looking for advanced modelers. If you are a beginner or only build basic geometry without nested parameters, this role is not for you).



-----------------------------

? What You’ll Do



Build complex parametric content: Create professional, lightweight Revit families from scratch using nested families, complex formulas, and advanced constraints.

Maintain strict quality: Follow our internal BIM standards for geometry, parameters, materials, and visibility.

Draft diverse assets: Work on furniture, plumbing fixtures, lighting, electrical, structural, and more.

Collaborate efficiently: Manage your workflow using Asana, Google Sheets, and shared QA checklists.

Advanced Parametric Experience: Proven ability to build highly flexible families (portfolio and .RFA samples are required).

Technical Mastery: Deep understanding of shared parameters, reference planes, type catalogs, and mathematical/logical formulas.

Professional Organization: Ability to structure and name parameters cleanly and logically.

Work Ethic: Strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and comfortable with English documentation.

Bonus: Experience modeling MEP or Structural content.



-----------------------------

Why Join Us?



100% Remote: Work from home with flexible hours.

Skill Growth: Get consistent feedback from industry experts to elevate your BIM skills.

Career Progression: Long-term collaboration with the potential to grow into a Senior Modeler or QA Leadership role.



-----------------------------

Location & Budget



This full-time freelance position is targeted toward candidates based in Southeast Asia (Philippines, Thailand, Myanmar, etc.), as our budget is benchmarked to competitive full-time freelance rates in these regions.





-----------------------------

How to Apply

1. Send an
 to 
 with the subject: Revit Family Modeler — [Your Name]

2. Please include:

---- A short introduction about your experience with complex parametric modeling.

---- Your portfolio (PDF or link).

---- 4–5 sample Revit families (.RFA format) demonstrating your highest level of parametric complexity.

---- Your current availability for full-time work.
